# Our chemistry builds a better tomorrow.

**As a leading polyurethane systems house, we develop sustainable chemical solutions for a wide
range of industries.**

#### [Contact Us ][64]

#### [Learn About FSI ][65]

### A World Leader in

## Polyurethane Technology and Solutions

### Custom Polyurethane Solutions

Our expert chemists work with customers to solve the toughest challenges and meet objectives through
the superiority of our chemical systems and custom polyurethane chemical formulas.

### Unsurpassed Technical & Customer Service

We serve our customers at any level they require – from helping companies start foaming their
products for the very first time, to developing intricate, specialized foam systems for others. With
the largest traveling service team and longest tenured team, we’re the go to choice for polyurethane
support.

### Innovative Equipment Solutions

FSI can provide exactly what you need for your specific situation — and assure your chemicals and
equipment solutions work together perfectly and consistently.

## See What We're About

][66]

##### Markets We Serve

### A leading polyurethane systems house specializing in custom solutions and distribution.

Our chemists specialize in creating custom polyurethane systems that solve technical challenges,
exceed environmental standards, and meet the demands of emerging markets. FSI collaborates with your
team to deliver the ideal product, process, and equipment solutions, ensuring optimal product
performance and immediate innovation.

#### [Explore the Markets Powered by Our Polyurethane Solutions ][67]

### Automotive

FSI supplies a wide range of flexible molded, slabstock, structural rigid, semi-rigid, integral skin
foam and RIM elastomer polyurethane systems

### Construction

High-performance polyurethane systems for residential, commercial and industrial construction
projects, from high R-value spray polyurethane foam (SPF) insulation to industrial-strength
adhesives with customized cure times.

### Marine & Recreation


FSI’s polyurethane systems offer durable flotation and comfortable seating for marine and
recreational use, ensuring long-lasting performance and reliability in tough conditions.

### Commercial Refrigeration

Our polyurethane systems offer superior thermal efficiency and long-lasting performance for
commercial refrigeration and appliance applications, ensuring energy savings and reliable operation
over time.

## Success Through Innovation

At FSI, **“Success Through Innovation”** isn’t just a slogan, it is our rolling history since our
beginning in 1972. We have patented technologies to improve performance of polyurethanes ranging
from advanced chemistry and blowing agent technologies to cutting-edge dispensing equipment &

## Ecomate® Blowing Agent Technology: Sustainable Performance Meets Environmental Standards

Since 2002, Ecomate has been field-proven as a successful alternative to environmentally harmful
blowing agents in a wide range of applications, from energy-efficient insulation in consumer
appliances to lightweight integral skin foam in automotive components.

Ecomate is:
* **Free of HFCs, HCFCs and CFCs**
* **Proven in both rigid and flexible foam applications**
* **Seamless system conversion with no new permits required**

Ecomate blown foams provide manufacturers with environmentally sustainable technology while
achieving processing and product performance standards. Our proprietary solution is PFAS-Free,
zero-GWP, non-VOC and meets the requirements of all applicable environmental regulations and
agreements.

[Learn about Ecomate][69]

## Polyurethane Foam: Common Questions and Expert Answers

### [What is the history of polyurethane?][70]

Polyurethane was first discovered in 1937 by Otto Bayer and made commercially available in the
1950s. Initially used as a coating material, it has since revolutionized a broad range of industries
with its flexibility and durability. It is now used in the production of insulation, foam
mattresses, car seats, shoe soles, and more.

### [What is the chemical structure of polyurethane foam?][71]

The chemical structure of polyurethane foam is based on the condensation reaction of an isocyanate
and a hydroxyl-containing compound, usually a polyol. This reaction creates cross-linked molecules
that form a flexible and durable foam when combined with a blowing agent.

### [How is polyurethane foam produced?][72]

Polyurethane foam is produced through either a liquid injection foam or slabstock foam process,
depending on the desired properties and intended use of the final product. Each method has its own
advantages and disadvantages, so finding the right method for a specific application is key to
achieving optimal results.

### [How strong is polyurethane foam?][73]

The strength of polyurethane foam depends on various factors including density and formulation, but
generally speaking it is known to be very resilient and durable material.

### [What is polyurethane used for?][74]

Polyurethane foam can be used for applications ranging from cushioning, soundproofing, impact
protection, energy absorption, thermal insulation, packaging materials and more.

### [Is polyurethane foam environmentally friendly?][75]

Most types of polyurethanes are non-toxic and considered environmentally friendly compared to other
materials such as oil-based plastics or foams made with CFCs (chlorofluorocarbons).

### [Are there any health risks associated with polyurethane foam?][76]

Generally speaking there are no health risks associated with using polyurethane foams but some
individuals may be sensitive to certain components such as diisocyanates which may cause irritation
when handled without proper protective equipment.

### [What are the 2 main types of polyurethane foam?][77]

Flexible foam, which is used mainly in cushioning and upholstery, and rigid foam, which is used
mainly in insulation and structural support.

### [What is a polyurethane systems house?][78]

Polyurethane systems houses provide comprehensive solutions for producing polyurethane chemical
systems, utilizing state-of-the-art production processes and customized options to ensure projects
are executed with precision and accuracy.

## Tailored support.

FSI serves manufacturers on an international scale with a sales, production and distribution network
that spans the globe.

## Ecomate® Blowing Agent Technology: Sustainable Performance Meets Environmental Standards

Since 2002, Ecomate has been field-proven as a successful alternative to environmentally harmful
blowing agents in a wide range of applications, from energy-efficient insulation in consumer
appliances to lightweight integral skin foam in automotive components.

Ecomate is:
* **Free of HFCs, HCFCs and CFCs**
* **Proven in both rigid and flexible foam applications**
* **Seamless system conversion with no new permits required**

Ecomate blown foams provide manufacturers with environmentally sustainable technology while
achieving processing and product performance standards. Our proprietary solution is PFAS-Free,
zero-GWP, non-VOC and meets the requirements of all applicable environmental regulations and
agreements.

[Learn about Ecomate][69]

## Polyurethane Foam: Common Questions and Expert Answers

### [What is the history of polyurethane?][70]

Polyurethane was first discovered in 1937 by Otto Bayer and made commercially available in the
1950s. Initially used as a coating material, it has since revolutionized a broad range of industries
with its flexibility and durability. It is now used in the production of insulation, foam
mattresses, car seats, shoe soles, and more.

### [What is the chemical structure of polyurethane foam?][71]

The chemical structure of polyurethane foam is based on the condensation reaction of an isocyanate
and a hydroxyl-containing compound, usually a polyol. This reaction creates cross-linked molecules
that form a flexible and durable foam when combined with a blowing agent.

### [How is polyurethane foam produced?][72]

Polyurethane foam is produced through either a liquid injection foam or slabstock foam process,
depending on the desired properties and intended use of the final product. Each method has its own
advantages and disadvantages, so finding the right method for a specific application is key to
achieving optimal results.

### [How strong is polyurethane foam?][73]

The strength of polyurethane foam depends on various factors including density and formulation, but
generally speaking it is known to be very resilient and durable material.

### [What is polyurethane used for?][74]

Polyurethane foam can be used for applications ranging from cushioning, soundproofing, impact
protection, energy absorption, thermal insulation, packaging materials and more.

### [Is polyurethane foam environmentally friendly?][75]

Most types of polyurethanes are non-toxic and considered environmentally friendly compared to other
materials such as oil-based plastics or foams made with CFCs (chlorofluorocarbons).

### [Are there any health risks associated with polyurethane foam?][76]

Generally speaking there are no health risks associated with using polyurethane foams but some
individuals may be sensitive to certain components such as diisocyanates which may cause irritation
when handled without proper protective equipment.

### [What are the 2 main types of polyurethane foam?][77]

Flexible foam, which is used mainly in cushioning and upholstery, and rigid foam, which is used
mainly in insulation and structural support.

### [What is a polyurethane systems house?][78]

Polyurethane systems houses provide comprehensive solutions for producing polyurethane chemical
systems, utilizing state-of-the-art production processes and customized options to ensure projects
are executed with precision and accuracy.

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

  ### [Markets][52]
  * #### [Aerospace & Defense][53]
    
    Advanced materials with high reliability under extreme conditions, critical for aerospace,
    commercial aircraft and defense applications.
  * #### [Automotive & EV/HEV][54]
    
    Rogers is a leading automotive advanced materials supplier with a wide range of industry
    solutions to power, protect and connect vehicles.
  * #### [Connected Devices][55]
    
    Enabling electronic devices and more to operate interactively or autonomously by use of wireless
    protocols.
  * #### [Footwear & Impact Safety][56]
    
    Advanced material technologies that provide flexible comfort and wearable impact protection.
  * #### [General Industrial][57]
    
    Industrial engineers and designers rely on Rogers’ advanced materials to enable reliability,
    efficiency and performance.
  * #### [Major Appliances][58]
    
    Rogers increases energy efficiency with high quality, performance-optimized power electronics.
  * #### [Medical][59]
    
    Rogers enables high quality patient care in applications ranging from medical instruments to
    patient cushioning and wound care.
  * #### [Portable Electronics][60]
    
    Rogers provides complex and compact electronics with superior fabrication and protection.
  * #### [Printing][61]
    
    R/bak® cushion mounting materials provide shock absorption, compressibility, improved
    registration and reduced dot gain in printing applications.
  * #### [Rail][62]
    
    Solutions to power and protect mass transit rail systems.
  * #### [Wind & Solar][63]
    
    Enabling system efficiency and reliability for wind and solar renewable energy sources.
  * #### [Wired Infrastructure and Data Centers][64]
    
    Materials for applications in data center & wired infrastructure environments.
  * #### [Wireless Infrastructure][65]
    
    Low-loss, high frequency advanced materials with well-controlled dielectric properties to enable
    microwave and RF applications, including mobile networks.

UFP Technologies

# Shaping Innovation

UFP Technologies is the trusted design, development, engineering, and manufacturing partner to turn
your vision into a reality through best-in-class comprehensive solutions primarily for medical
devices and sterile packaging, as well as other highly engineered custom products.

MedTech

MedTech evolves at breathtaking speeds. To keep pace, you need forward-thinking collaboration to
develop your idea and anticipate the challenges at each phase of the process. UFP MedTech is the
ideal partner to help you accelerate single-use and single patient devices from development through
launch and manufacturing.

[ Learn More ][54]

Advanced Components

For aerospace, defense, automotive, and other highly engineered components and packaging, our
advanced engineering capabilities and materials expertise ensures optimal designs and seamless
implementation to make your vision a reality.

[ Learn More ][55]
[Surgeon in blue scrubs and mask uses a microscope in a surgical setting; tools and a medical case
are visible nearby.]

Full-Service Process

## Design & Development through Manufacturing

Trust UFP Technologies to turn your vision into reality with best-in-class comprehensive solutions
based on our vast depth of engineering expertise. Our nimble and dynamic team will work with you to
create custom designs from foams, films, plastics, nonwovens, fabrics, and other specialty
materials. All with the ultimate goal of positioning your ideas for success.

Customer
Challenge

From the initial stages of development, we review your project from every angle, assigning a
dedicated team to fully understand the unique needs and potential challenges before we start.

Design
& Material Selection

We act as an extension of your R&D and engineering teams, applying our vast materials expertise and
design skills, so that each decision we make is optimized for the application.

Engineering
& Prototyping

We understand the importance of delivering sound engineering and rapid prototypes. Our in-house
tooling capabilities and custom equipment allow us to execute quickly and accurately, producing
prototypes within 72 hours.

Pre-Production
Validation

Mitigating any potential risks through quality management systems ensures a seamless transition from
prototype to full-scale production.

Commercial
Production

Our turnkey solutions include high volume manufacturing, packaging, and supply chain management
through multiple global locations to get your product to market quickly and efficiently.

Careers

## It's great to be here!

If you’re looking for a professional, energetic, family-oriented work environment that fosters
professional development and career advancement, you’re ready for UFP.

UFP Technologies

# Shaping Innovation

UFP Technologies is the trusted design, development, engineering, and manufacturing partner to turn
your vision into a reality through best-in-class comprehensive solutions primarily for medical
devices and sterile packaging, as well as other highly engineered custom products.

MedTech

MedTech evolves at breathtaking speeds. To keep pace, you need forward-thinking collaboration to
develop your idea and anticipate the challenges at each phase of the process. UFP MedTech is the
ideal partner to help you accelerate single-use and single patient devices from development through
launch and manufacturing.

[ Learn More ][54]

Advanced Components

For aerospace, defense, automotive, and other highly engineered components and packaging, our
advanced engineering capabilities and materials expertise ensures optimal designs and seamless
implementation to make your vision a reality.

[ Learn More ][55]
[Surgeon in blue scrubs and mask uses a microscope in a surgical setting; tools and a medical case
are visible nearby.]

Full-Service Process

## Design & Development through Manufacturing

Trust UFP Technologies to turn your vision into reality with best-in-class comprehensive solutions
based on our vast depth of engineering expertise. Our nimble and dynamic team will work with you to
create custom designs from foams, films, plastics, nonwovens, fabrics, and other specialty
materials. All with the ultimate goal of positioning your ideas for success.

Customer
Challenge

From the initial stages of development, we review your project from every angle, assigning a
dedicated team to fully understand the unique needs and potential challenges before we start.

Design
& Material Selection

We act as an extension of your R&D and engineering teams, applying our vast materials expertise and
design skills, so that each decision we make is optimized for the application.

Engineering
& Prototyping

We understand the importance of delivering sound engineering and rapid prototypes. Our in-house
tooling capabilities and custom equipment allow us to execute quickly and accurately, producing
prototypes within 72 hours.

Pre-Production
Validation

Mitigating any potential risks through quality management systems ensures a seamless transition from
prototype to full-scale production.

Commercial
Production

Our turnkey solutions include high volume manufacturing, packaging, and supply chain management
through multiple global locations to get your product to market quickly and efficiently.

Careers

## It's great to be here!

If you’re looking for a professional, energetic, family-oriented work environment that fosters
professional development and career advancement, you’re ready for UFP.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’re dedicated to recycling machinery that combines efficiency, durability and value. Visit our
factory and experience our work firsthand.

[Talk to engineering →][135]

### What types of plastic recycling machines do you manufacture?

We manufacture the full range of plastic recycling equipment: [shredders][136] (single- and
double-shaft), [granulators / crushers][137], [washing lines][138] for film, PET bottles and rigid
plastics, [drying systems][139] (centrifugal & thermal) and [pelletizers][140] (strand, water-ring,
cutter-compactor). Plus auxiliary equipment: magnetic separators, conveyors and balers.

### What is the typical plastic recycling process?

A standard mechanical recycling line follows: **shredding/granulation** (size reduction),
**washing** (hot wash, friction wash and rinsing), **separation** (sink–float tanks and air
classifiers), **drying** (centrifugal dewatering plus thermal drying) and **pelletizing** (extrusion
into uniform pellets). The exact configuration depends on input material and target output quality.

### How much does a plastic recycling machine cost?

Individual machines start from $8,000–$15,000. A complete washing line typically ranges
$80,000–$300,000, and a full washing + pelletizing system $200,000–$500,000 — depending on capacity
(300–3,000 kg/h), automation level and material. [Contact us][141] with your material, target output
and throughput for accurate pricing.

### What is the manufacturing lead time, and can I test the machines?

Standard machines: ~30–45 days post-contract. Complete lines: 60–90 days. Custom projects: per
contract. We perform a comprehensive trial run on every complete system before shipment — attend in
person at our factory or via video call.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We’re dedicated to recycling machinery that combines efficiency, durability and value. Visit our
factory and experience our work firsthand.

[Talk to engineering →][135]

### What types of plastic recycling machines do you manufacture?

We manufacture the full range of plastic recycling equipment: [shredders][136] (single- and
double-shaft), [granulators / crushers][137], [washing lines][138] for film, PET bottles and rigid
plastics, [drying systems][139] (centrifugal & thermal) and [pelletizers][140] (strand, water-ring,
cutter-compactor). Plus auxiliary equipment: magnetic separators, conveyors and balers.

### What is the typical plastic recycling process?

A standard mechanical recycling line follows: **shredding/granulation** (size reduction),
**washing** (hot wash, friction wash and rinsing), **separation** (sink–float tanks and air
classifiers), **drying** (centrifugal dewatering plus thermal drying) and **pelletizing** (extrusion
into uniform pellets). The exact configuration depends on input material and target output quality.

### How much does a plastic recycling machine cost?

Individual machines start from $8,000–$15,000. A complete washing line typically ranges
$80,000–$300,000, and a full washing + pelletizing system $200,000–$500,000 — depending on capacity
(300–3,000 kg/h), automation level and material. [Contact us][141] with your material, target output
and throughput for accurate pricing.

### What is the manufacturing lead time, and can I test the machines?

Standard machines: ~30–45 days post-contract. Complete lines: 60–90 days. Custom projects: per
contract. We perform a comprehensive trial run on every complete system before shipment — attend in
person at our factory or via video call.

application and budget, and our fabricating capabilities—lamination, slitting, rotary and flat bed
die cutting, spooling, and more—create custom tape, gasketing, and insulation parts that slash
assembly times and minimize labor requirements.

### We partner with leading suppliers to bring you a comprehensive catalog of pressure sensitive

Having worked on thousands of projects, we know what works and what doesn’t. We’ll help you find the
best materials and products for your application, and we partner with leading suppliers to ensure

With decades of history working together, these supplier relationships run deep. Our longstanding

custom products, which include custom kitting and nested parts, allow you to decrease assembly time

## **Making your life easier, safer and more productive.**

### Expanded Polystyrene news, knowledge & sustainable solutions.

### In your home, in your community and in business, state-of-the-art EPS manufacturing technologies
### create products with reliable performance. EPS delivers fresh food to your dinner table, safely
### ships important medical treatment and keeps your home and other buildings cooler in the summer
### and warmer in the winter.

### ***Touching your life in so many ways.

### Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) is a sustainable solution that can be used to keep us warm, safe, and
### healthy while remaining cost-effective and recyclable. This video offers insights into the world
### of EPS, highlighting the positive contributions EPS makes in our lives.

## **WHAT IS EPS?**

## **MORE ABOUT EPS.**

The EPS Industry Alliance (EPS-IA) is the North American trade association for the expanded
polystyrene (EPS) industry. Our members – more than 50 small businesses located in 44 states –
manufacture EPS foam insulation used in building and construction and EPS protective packaging for
consumer goods including appliances, electronics, pharmaceuticals, furniture, and other products.
EPS is a versatile, lightweight material — 98 percent air —that supports a diverse range of
industries and significant sectors of our national economy.

EPS offers a unique combination of performance characteristics including high shock absorption, high
thermal resistance and high compressive strength. These properties are further enhanced by the
ability to customize EPS into unlimited shapes and sizes, enabling it to meet specifications for
hundreds of highly engineered applications. EPS insulation promotes faster construction times and
contributes to significant energy savings. Cold chain shipping, radiant floor heating, highway
bridge abutments, automotive safety components, and life-saving sports helmets are just some of the
important ways EPS contributes to a safer, healthier and more energy efficient society.

Health & Safety
As part of the chemical industry, EUROPUR is committed to Reponsible CareTM.
We seek to continuously improve the environmental, health and safety
knowledge and performance of our technologies, processes and products over their lifecycles.
[Discover more][83]
Sustainability
We are committed to transition to a circular economy. Flexible polyurethane foam is a fully
recyclable material. With recent development of technology, we can expect polyurethane to have
limitless cycles of recycling and thus becoming fully circular.
[Discover more][84]
CertiPUR
CertiPUR is a voluntary testing, analysis and certification
programme for the environment, health and safety properties of
polyurethane foam used in bedding and upholstered furniture applications
[Discover more][85]

Health & Safety
As part of the chemical industry, EUROPUR is committed to Reponsible CareTM.
We seek to continuously improve the environmental, health and safety
knowledge and performance of our technologies, processes and products over their lifecycles.
[Discover more][83]
Sustainability
We are committed to transition to a circular economy. Flexible polyurethane foam is a fully
recyclable material. With recent development of technology, we can expect polyurethane to have
limitless cycles of recycling and thus becoming fully circular.
[Discover more][84]

programme for the environment, health and safety properties of
polyurethane foam used in bedding and upholstered furniture applications

Welcome to Foam Factory’s wholesale website, FoamDistributing.com. Here, we offer a variety of
high-quality products and materials at [wholesale foam][46] prices! Whether you’re a business trying
to find a low-cost, hassle-free foam material supplier, or an individual on a quest for great prices
on premium foam materials, Foam Factory has just what you’ve been looking for.

With Foam Factory’s wholesale pricing, what you see is what you get. This is great for small
businesses and upholstery shops looking for a bulk supplier, because every penny counts and being
able to accurately budget keeps things running smoothly. The last thing any company wants is to
receive an invoice with extra pop-up fees because of services or charges that were only mentioned
after the fact. Without tiered pricing, you’ll never have to buy more than you need to get the best
deal on an item either, whether you’re ordering 1 or 100. Individual customers are welcome to take
advantage of our wholesale pricing as well. There’s no need to register or represent a business or
organization to get the most competitive foam pricing on the net.

In addition to bulk polyurethane foam, great for [cushion supply][47], Foam Factory offers a
selection of acoustic foam sound treatment products at wholesale prices. Terrific for taming mid and
high-frequency reflections and echoes, acoustical wedge foam and acoustical eggcrate foam can
improve the clarity of your listening room or recording space without spending an arm and a leg. In
addition to the wedge and eggcrate foam tiles, we also offer wholesale bass and broadband treatment,
all available in rich, vibrant colors to help your room look as great as it will sound.

Memory foam sheets are another product offered at low, wholesale prices. Sold in standard mattress
sizes and various thicknesses, these can be used to build a custom mattress, used as a memory foam
topper, or turned into a memory foam cushion. Memory foam is temperature-sensitive and softens with
the heat from the user’s body. This creates custom contouring that greatly relieves pressure and
improves comfort in any application.

At Foam Factory, we specialize in [polyurethane foam sheets][48], packaging foam, and specialty foam
materials like rebond and Dryfast outdoor cushion foam. We have all the wholesale upholstery and
comfort materials you could need at great prices. So if it’s foam you need, and low prices you want,
FoamDistributing.com from Foam Factory is right for you!

businesses and upholstery shops looking for a bulk supplier, because every penny counts and being

selection of acoustic foam sound treatment products at wholesale prices. Terrific for taming mid and
high-frequency reflections and echoes, acoustical wedge foam and acoustical eggcrate foam can
improve the clarity of your listening room or recording space without spending an arm and a leg. In
addition to the wedge and eggcrate foam tiles, we also offer wholesale bass and broadband treatment,
all available in rich, vibrant colors to help your room look as great as it will sound.

the heat from the user’s body. This creates custom contouring that greatly relieves pressure and
improves comfort in any application.

materials like rebond and Dryfast outdoor cushion foam. We have all the wholesale upholstery and
comfort materials you could need at great prices. So if it’s foam you need, and low prices you want,

# Home

[Header-01]
[banner2]

##### บริการผลิตสินค้า PU Foam แบบครบวงจร

##### ผลิตสินค้าในหลากหลายอุตสาหกรรม รับผลิตสินค้า OEM
##### ตอบโจทย์ทุกความต้องการ ด้วยกำลังการผลิตที่เพียงพอ

[ อ่านต่อ ][68]

#### วัสดุที่มีความยืดหยุ่นสูง อายุการใช้งานยาวนาน

### Flexible Foam

[ อ่านต่อ ][69]

#### โฟมที่มีความหนาแน่นสูง ช่วยในเรื่องการกระจายแรงกดทับ

### Memory Foam

[ อ่านต่อ ][70]

#### เป็นฉนวนความร้อนที่ยอดเยี่ยม และมีน้ำหนักเบา

### Rigid Foam

[ อ่านต่อ ][71]

#### วัสดุอเนกประสงค์ ด้วยพื้นผิวที่สวยงามและใช้งานคงทน

### Integral Skin Foam

[ อ่านต่อ ][72]

#### วัสดุมีความหนาแน่นสูง ผิวสัมผัสคล้ายยางพารา

### MCU Elastomers

##### One Stop Process

##### เชี่ยวชาญการผลิต PU Foam ในทุกขั้นตอน
##### ด้วยเทคนิคเฉพาะ เครื่องจักร และอุปกรณ์ที่มีประสิทธิภาพ

[icon2]

#### Chemical Blending

##### (พัฒนาสูตรเคมี)

เราผสมสูตรเคมีด้วยตัวเอง

โดยเคมีที่เราพัฒนาขึ้นมาจะต้องผ่านการทดสอบมากมาย

เพื่อให้เป็นตามมาตรฐานสากล

[ อ่านต่อ ][73]
[icon1]

#### Mold Maker

##### (ผลิตแม่พิมพ์)

ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐาน

ISO9001 และมีผู้เชี่ยวชาญที่ดูแลตั้งแต่การออกแบบแม่พิมพ์
ไปจนถึงการผลิตแม่พิมพ์

[ อ่านต่อ ][74]
[icon4]

#### PU Injection Machine

##### (ผลิตเครื่องฉีดโฟม)

คิดค้นและสร้างเครื่องฉีดโฟม
ของตัวเองขึ้นมา และได้รับการยอมรับจาก UNDP และได้รับการจดสิทธิบัตรอีกด้วย

[ อ่านต่อ ][75]
[icon3]

#### Insert Maker

##### (ผลิตเครื่องจักรอื่นๆ)

ช่วยให้ทำงานได้รวดเร็ว
และแม่นยำมากขึ้น
ลดความผิดพลาดส่วนบุคคล
ที่อาจจะเกิดขึ้นได้

[ อ่านต่อ ][76]

##### Our Vision

เป็นบริษัทโพลียูรีเทนไทยชั้นนำ
พัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์ด้วยนวัตกรรม

ทุกอุตสากรรม เป็นเจ้าของแบรนด์ไทย ก้าวไกลสู่เวทีการค้าสากล

##### การันตีคุณภาพด้วยมาตรฐานและรางวัลระดับสากล

ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐาน ISO9001:2015 และ IATF16949:2016
ทั้งระบบการผลิต PU และการผลิตแม่พิมพ์ รวมถึงรางวัลทั้งในไทย
และระดับสากลอย่างต่อเนื่องตลอดหลายปีที่ผ่านมา

# Home

[Header-01]
[banner2]

##### บริการผลิตสินค้า PU Foam แบบครบวงจร

##### ผลิตสินค้าในหลากหลายอุตสาหกรรม รับผลิตสินค้า OEM
##### ตอบโจทย์ทุกความต้องการ ด้วยกำลังการผลิตที่เพียงพอ

[ อ่านต่อ ][68]

#### วัสดุที่มีความยืดหยุ่นสูง อายุการใช้งานยาวนาน

### Flexible Foam

[ อ่านต่อ ][69]

#### โฟมที่มีความหนาแน่นสูง ช่วยในเรื่องการกระจายแรงกดทับ

### Memory Foam

[ อ่านต่อ ][70]

#### เป็นฉนวนความร้อนที่ยอดเยี่ยม และมีน้ำหนักเบา

### Rigid Foam

[ อ่านต่อ ][71]

#### วัสดุอเนกประสงค์ ด้วยพื้นผิวที่สวยงามและใช้งานคงทน

### Integral Skin Foam

[ อ่านต่อ ][72]

#### วัสดุมีความหนาแน่นสูง ผิวสัมผัสคล้ายยางพารา

### MCU Elastomers

##### One Stop Process

##### เชี่ยวชาญการผลิต PU Foam ในทุกขั้นตอน
##### ด้วยเทคนิคเฉพาะ เครื่องจักร และอุปกรณ์ที่มีประสิทธิภาพ

[icon2]

#### Chemical Blending

##### (พัฒนาสูตรเคมี)

เราผสมสูตรเคมีด้วยตัวเอง

โดยเคมีที่เราพัฒนาขึ้นมาจะต้องผ่านการทดสอบมากมาย

เพื่อให้เป็นตามมาตรฐานสากล

[ อ่านต่อ ][73]
[icon1]

#### Mold Maker

##### (ผลิตแม่พิมพ์)

ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐาน

ISO9001 และมีผู้เชี่ยวชาญที่ดูแลตั้งแต่การออกแบบแม่พิมพ์
ไปจนถึงการผลิตแม่พิมพ์

[ อ่านต่อ ][74]
[icon4]

#### PU Injection Machine

##### (ผลิตเครื่องฉีดโฟม)

คิดค้นและสร้างเครื่องฉีดโฟม
ของตัวเองขึ้นมา และได้รับการยอมรับจาก UNDP และได้รับการจดสิทธิบัตรอีกด้วย

[ อ่านต่อ ][75]
[icon3]

#### Insert Maker

##### (ผลิตเครื่องจักรอื่นๆ)

ช่วยให้ทำงานได้รวดเร็ว
และแม่นยำมากขึ้น
ลดความผิดพลาดส่วนบุคคล
ที่อาจจะเกิดขึ้นได้

[ อ่านต่อ ][76]

##### Our Vision

เป็นบริษัทโพลียูรีเทนไทยชั้นนำ
พัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์ด้วยนวัตกรรม

ทุกอุตสากรรม เป็นเจ้าของแบรนด์ไทย ก้าวไกลสู่เวทีการค้าสากล

##### การันตีคุณภาพด้วยมาตรฐานและรางวัลระดับสากล

ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐาน ISO9001:2015 และ IATF16949:2016
ทั้งระบบการผลิต PU และการผลิตแม่พิมพ์ รวมถึงรางวัลทั้งในไทย
และระดับสากลอย่างต่อเนื่องตลอดหลายปีที่ผ่านมา

[ Overmolding ][42]

In overmolding, when the first layer of resin cools, a second layer of material is injected over it.
We provide this service and can source all the requisite materials for you.

## Quality Is in Every Injection Mold and Plastic Parts

FOW takes care of all manufacturing tasks in house thus we are able to offer you an accuracy range
within 0.005mm for all molds and well-made injection molded parts.

FOW only uses high-quality metal steel for injection molds and qualified resin for plastic parts. We
are happy to provide composition analysis and other necessary test documents.

From raw material inspection and quality control through out the production process, we set up
strict standards and make sure that everything undergoes through the quality system.

## Work with Our Experts for Customized
## Injection Molds and Products

Our team of designers and injection molding engineering experts are highly-qualified and
well-experienced in their craft. They keep up with evolving injection moulding industry trends and
are continuously innovating new cutting-edge solutions.

When you entrust us with your injection molding project, we handle it with utmost professionalism
and dedication. Every design detail will be custom-made to match your requirements and ease your
manufacturing process. 

We guarantee you a stress-free customer experience and complete discretion on all intellectual
property. Look no further. [Contact us][44] today and let us get started on your project. 

[our engineer team]

## Your Trusted Plastic Injection Molding Factory in China

FOW has an annual capability of 900 molds, 300 of which are bucket molds. Started from bucket molds,
we have expanded our mold-making and injection molding service to industries in warehouse & storage,
baby products, furniture, automobile and home appliances over the years. Our team of experienced
engineers can help you achieve an one-stop solution with both high quality and affordable injection
molding cost in China.

### WELCOME TO
### INTCO RECYCLING


INTCO Recycling is a foam recycling specialist, providing a total solution to EPS/EPE/EPP foam
recycling. We manufacture and sell GREENMAX foam compactor/densifier and foam recycling machine, buy
compressed foam blocks, and turn them into frame products.



Every year, INTCO Recycling recycles 100,000 tons of waste EPS, which helps reduce 300,000 tons of
carbon emissions. INTCO has become one of the biggest waste EPS end-user and recyclers in the world.

### WELCOME TO
### INTCO RECYCLING


INTCO Recycling is a foam recycling specialist, providing a total solution to EPS/EPE/EPP foam
recycling. We manufacture and sell GREENMAX foam compactor/densifier and foam recycling machine, buy
compressed foam blocks, and turn them into frame products.



Every year, INTCO Recycling recycles 100,000 tons of waste EPS, which helps reduce 300,000 tons of
carbon emissions. INTCO has become one of the biggest waste EPS end-user and recyclers in the world.

**We accelerate science, technological research and transfer to the aeronautics and space industries
for the development of reliable, robust, certifiable and sustainable innovative solutions.**

At our sites in Toulouse, Bordeaux and Sophia Antipolis, we offer an integrated collaborative
environment composed of engineers, researchers, experts and PhD students from academia and industry
for research projects and R&T services supported by technological platforms around 4 axes: advanced
manufacturing technologies, greener technologies, smart technologies and methods & tools for the
development of complex systems.
Our developed technologies meet the needs of industry, integrating the results of academic research.

We are a private research foundation, supported by the French government, which funds projects in
proportion to the industrial contribution and defines the regulatory framework of the foundation.

At our sites in Toulouse, Bordeaux and Sophia Antipolis, we offer an integrated collaborative
environment composed of engineers, researchers, experts and PhD students from academia and industry
for research projects and R&T services supported by technological platforms around 4 axes: advanced
manufacturing technologies, greener technologies, smart technologies and methods & tools for the
development of complex systems.
Our developed technologies meet the needs of industry, integrating the results of academic research.

## ABOUT US

ISANTE HOME is a leading manufacturer and exporter of polyurethane foam products in China. The
production base is located in Nantong City, a region renowned as “the home products base of China.”

The factory is ISO 9001:2008 certified and spans an area of 30,000 ㎡. Consequently, it attracts
100+ skilled professionals. The entire organization operates under the 5S management principle,
ensuring continuous improvement and the comprehensive development of its workforce.

ISANTE HOME is equipped with multiple fully automated PU mold foaming assembly lines, alongside
advanced production and testing facilities. These include state-of-the-art CNC cutting machines,
ground track cutting machines, carousel foam cutting machines, universal tension testing machines,
foam pressing machines, as well as constant temperature and humidity testing equipment. This enables
the company to deliver consistently high-quality products that meet international standards such as
REACH, OEKO-TEX, and CertiPUR-US. To date, ISANTE HOME’s products have been successfully exported to
more than 30 countries worldwide.

## FAQ

Here are some of the questions you may be concerned about to cooperate more smoothly

What is your quality control processes?

As a leading foam product manufacturer and exporter, we prioritize quality control at every stage of
production to ensure that our products consistently meet or exceed the highest industry standards.
Here’s a brief overview of our quality control processes:
1. **Maintaining Standards throughout Production:** We maintain standards throughout production by
implementing strict quality control checkpoints at various stages of the manufacturing process.
These checkpoints ensure that each step adheres to our established standards and specifications.
2. **Testing Methods:** We employ a range of testing methods to assess the quality of our foam
products. This includes mechanical testing, dimensional analysis, density measurement, compression
testing, tensile strength testing, and flammability testing, among others. We use industry-standard
testing equipment and procedures to ensure accuracy and reliability.
**3. Addressing Quality Issues:** If any quality issues arise, we have established procedures for
addressing them promptly and effectively. This involves identifying the root cause of the issue
through thorough investigation and analysis. Once the root cause is determined, corrective actions
are implemented to prevent recurrence. We prioritize open communication with our customers and
provide prompt resolution to any quality concerns they may have.
Overall, our quality control processes are designed to ensure that our foam products meet the
highest standards of quality, consistency, and reliability, providing our customers with confidence
in the products they receive.



Are customization options acceptable?

Yes. We place great emphasis on meeting the individual needs of our customers. You can make
customized requests according to your own needs, and we will do our best to meet your expectations.
Whether it is size, shape, color or other special requirements, we will do our best to cooperate to
ensure that you get a satisfactory product. Because of many years of OEM and ODM experience, we are
familiar with the special needs of different markets for products, so when you put forward
customized requirements, we will give you some professional suggestions so that you can better
develop the market. Any customization needs, please feel free to contact us, we will provide you
with professional advice and solutions.

How about your delivery time and production capacity?

We arrange the production according to the order sequence. The regular delivery time of orders
without customization requirements is 30 days, and the orders with customization requirements need
to be communicated according to the actual situation.
Our production capacity is as follows:
**1. Molded memory foam pillow:** 60,000 pieces/month, the specific production capacity of a single
product is determined by the number of available molds.
**2. Cutting foam or regular foam pillow:** 45,000 pieces/month.
**3. Memory foam or regular foam topper:** 100,000 pieces/month.
**4. Memory foam Mattress:** 80,000 pieces/month.
**5. Shaped cutting foam products: **depending on the complexity of the shapes.
**6. Pet bed:** depending on the comlexity of the bed.
**7. Memory foam or regular foam block: **15,000 meters/month.

Do you have MOQ requirement to the orders?

Yes. As a leading foam product manufacturer and exporter, we typically have minimum order quantity
(MOQ) requirements for our products. However, these requirements can vary depending on factors such
as the type of product, its specifications, customization options, and production capacity.
For standard foam products and popular products that are regularly produced in high volumes, we may
have relatively lower MOQs to accommodate a wide range of customers, including wholesalers,
distributors, and retailers. This allows smaller businesses to access our products without needing
to place excessively large orders.
On the other hand, for custom or specialized foam products that require unique specifications,
designs, or materials, the MOQs may be higher to justify the setup costs and ensure economical
production runs.
Our MOQs are typically communicated to customers during the quotation or negotiation process, and we
strive to be flexible and accommodating to meet the needs of our diverse customer base while
maintaining cost-effective production processes.
Ultimately, our goal is to provide high-quality foam products to our customers while balancing the
economies of scale with the specific requirements of each order. We work closely with our customers
to determine the most suitable MOQs based on their needs, market demands, and production
capabilities.

How about your communication channels and support?

We prioritize effective communication and provide dedicated support to our customers throughout
their experience with us. Multiple communication channels are offered to accommodate the preferences
and needs of our customers such as email, phone, live chat by instant chat app , and dedicated
customer portals for order management and support.
Our goal of response time is to acknowledge inquiries within 24 hours or less, depending on the
complexity of the request. Urgent inquiries receive immediate attention to ensure prompt resolution,

## FAQ

Here are some of the questions you may be concerned about to cooperate more smoothly

What is your quality control processes?

As a leading foam product manufacturer and exporter, we prioritize quality control at every stage of
production to ensure that our products consistently meet or exceed the highest industry standards.
Here’s a brief overview of our quality control processes:
1. **Maintaining Standards throughout Production:** We maintain standards throughout production by
implementing strict quality control checkpoints at various stages of the manufacturing process.
These checkpoints ensure that each step adheres to our established standards and specifications.
2. **Testing Methods:** We employ a range of testing methods to assess the quality of our foam
products. This includes mechanical testing, dimensional analysis, density measurement, compression
testing, tensile strength testing, and flammability testing, among others. We use industry-standard
testing equipment and procedures to ensure accuracy and reliability.
**3. Addressing Quality Issues:** If any quality issues arise, we have established procedures for
addressing them promptly and effectively. This involves identifying the root cause of the issue
through thorough investigation and analysis. Once the root cause is determined, corrective actions
are implemented to prevent recurrence. We prioritize open communication with our customers and
provide prompt resolution to any quality concerns they may have.
Overall, our quality control processes are designed to ensure that our foam products meet the
highest standards of quality, consistency, and reliability, providing our customers with confidence
in the products they receive.



Are customization options acceptable?

Yes. We place great emphasis on meeting the individual needs of our customers. You can make
customized requests according to your own needs, and we will do our best to meet your expectations.
Whether it is size, shape, color or other special requirements, we will do our best to cooperate to
ensure that you get a satisfactory product. Because of many years of OEM and ODM experience, we are
familiar with the special needs of different markets for products, so when you put forward
customized requirements, we will give you some professional suggestions so that you can better
develop the market. Any customization needs, please feel free to contact us, we will provide you
with professional advice and solutions.

How about your delivery time and production capacity?

We arrange the production according to the order sequence. The regular delivery time of orders
without customization requirements is 30 days, and the orders with customization requirements need
to be communicated according to the actual situation.
Our production capacity is as follows:
**1. Molded memory foam pillow:** 60,000 pieces/month, the specific production capacity of a single
product is determined by the number of available molds.
**2. Cutting foam or regular foam pillow:** 45,000 pieces/month.
**3. Memory foam or regular foam topper:** 100,000 pieces/month.
**4. Memory foam Mattress:** 80,000 pieces/month.
**5. Shaped cutting foam products: **depending on the complexity of the shapes.
**6. Pet bed:** depending on the comlexity of the bed.
**7. Memory foam or regular foam block: **15,000 meters/month.

Do you have MOQ requirement to the orders?

Yes. As a leading foam product manufacturer and exporter, we typically have minimum order quantity
(MOQ) requirements for our products. However, these requirements can vary depending on factors such
as the type of product, its specifications, customization options, and production capacity.
For standard foam products and popular products that are regularly produced in high volumes, we may
have relatively lower MOQs to accommodate a wide range of customers, including wholesalers,
distributors, and retailers. This allows smaller businesses to access our products without needing
to place excessively large orders.
On the other hand, for custom or specialized foam products that require unique specifications,
designs, or materials, the MOQs may be higher to justify the setup costs and ensure economical
production runs.
Our MOQs are typically communicated to customers during the quotation or negotiation process, and we
strive to be flexible and accommodating to meet the needs of our diverse customer base while
maintaining cost-effective production processes.
Ultimately, our goal is to provide high-quality foam products to our customers while balancing the
economies of scale with the specific requirements of each order. We work closely with our customers
to determine the most suitable MOQs based on their needs, market demands, and production
capabilities.

How about your communication channels and support?

We prioritize effective communication and provide dedicated support to our customers throughout
their experience with us. Multiple communication channels are offered to accommodate the preferences
and needs of our customers such as email, phone, live chat by instant chat app , and dedicated
customer portals for order management and support.
Our goal of response time is to acknowledge inquiries within 24 hours or less, depending on the
complexity of the request. Urgent inquiries receive immediate attention to ensure prompt resolution,

## FAQs About Polyurethane Foam Manufacturers

What is reticulated foam used for?

Reticulated foam is widely used for filtration, sound absorption, fluid management, cleaning
products, paint rollers, and cushioning in industrial and consumer applications due to its open-cell
structure.

What is the difference between reticulated and non-reticulated foam?

Reticulated foam has an open-cell structure that allows air, water, and sound to pass through,
making it ideal for filtration and absorption. Non-reticulated foam has a closed-cell structure,
which provides higher insulation and cushioning but less breathability.

What are the different types of filter foam?

Filter foams are available in polyether-based foams, polyester-based foams, and specialized
engineered foams. They vary in porosity and density depending on whether they are used for air,
liquid, or acoustic filtration.

How is reticulated foam made?

Reticulated foam is made by removing the cell membranes of conventional polyurethane foam using
chemical or thermal reticulation processes, resulting in a highly porous open-cell structure.

What is the quality of good foam?

Good foam should have consistent density, resilience, durability, uniform cell structure, and meet
performance requirements like comfort, filtration efficiency, or load-bearing capacity depending on
its application.

What are the raw materials of polyurethane foam?

Polyurethane foam is primarily made from polyols and isocyanates, combined with blowing agents,
catalysts, and additives that determine the foam’s flexibility, density, and performance.

Where does polyurethane foam come from?

Polyurethane foam originates from chemical reactions between petroleum-based polyols and
isocyanates, developed during the 20th century, and is now manufactured globally for industrial and
consumer use.

Who are the leading foam manufacturers in India?

Karefoam is among the leading foam manufacturers in India, offering engineered polyurethane foam
solutions for automotive, filtration, comfort systems, and industrial applications.

What makes Karefoam a reliable polyurethane foam manufacturer?

 Karefoam combines advanced engineering, strict quality processes, and decades of expertise to
produce polyurethane foams that meet global standards for performance and durability.

Why choose an industrial foam manufacturer like Karefoam?

As an industrial foam manufacturer, Karefoam delivers large-scale, high-quality, engineered foam
components designed to meet specific industry standards and applications.

## FAQs About Polyurethane Foam Manufacturers

What is reticulated foam used for?

Reticulated foam is widely used for filtration, sound absorption, fluid management, cleaning
products, paint rollers, and cushioning in industrial and consumer applications due to its open-cell
structure.

What is the difference between reticulated and non-reticulated foam?

Reticulated foam has an open-cell structure that allows air, water, and sound to pass through,
making it ideal for filtration and absorption. Non-reticulated foam has a closed-cell structure,
which provides higher insulation and cushioning but less breathability.

What are the different types of filter foam?

Filter foams are available in polyether-based foams, polyester-based foams, and specialized
engineered foams. They vary in porosity and density depending on whether they are used for air,
liquid, or acoustic filtration.

How is reticulated foam made?

Reticulated foam is made by removing the cell membranes of conventional polyurethane foam using
chemical or thermal reticulation processes, resulting in a highly porous open-cell structure.

What is the quality of good foam?

Good foam should have consistent density, resilience, durability, uniform cell structure, and meet
performance requirements like comfort, filtration efficiency, or load-bearing capacity depending on
its application.

What are the raw materials of polyurethane foam?

Polyurethane foam is primarily made from polyols and isocyanates, combined with blowing agents,
catalysts, and additives that determine the foam’s flexibility, density, and performance.

Where does polyurethane foam come from?

Polyurethane foam originates from chemical reactions between petroleum-based polyols and
isocyanates, developed during the 20th century, and is now manufactured globally for industrial and
consumer use.

solutions for automotive, filtration, comfort systems, and industrial applications.

## **Bespoke foam solutions, engineered for precision**

Welcome to Kewell Converters, where bespoke foam conversion and foam fabrication are at the heart of
everything we do. With over 50 years of exclusive experience working with foam materials, we’re the
UK’s most experienced independent foam converter—trusted by procurement teams and engineers in the
[aerospace][58], military, [defence][59], and [industrial][60] sectors.

We don’t just manufacture components—we solve problems. Our expert engineering [team][61], paired
with our full CAD design service, develops specialised foam solutions that meet exact performance,
durability, and environmental requirements. Whether you’re looking for custom foam inserts,
protective foam packaging, or engineered foam parts, we deliver with precision, speed and technical
confidence.

[Find out more][62]

## **Uncompromising on **[**quality**][63]

**Certified to ISO 9001:2015 – because quality can’t be optional**

At Kewell Converters, quality is built into every layer of our process. We operate to [ISO
9001:2015][64] standards, ensuring consistently high-quality foam parts and bespoke foam solutions
that meet even the strictest tolerances.

This matters most in high-risk sectors like [defence][65] and [aerospace][66], where performance
must be proven and reliability is non-negotiable. With a team of 30 skilled professionals and an
advanced production facility, we guarantee attention to detail, accountability, and dependable
delivery across every project.

## **Bespoke foam solutions, engineered for precision**

Welcome to Kewell Converters, where bespoke foam conversion and foam fabrication are at the heart of
everything we do. With over 50 years of exclusive experience working with foam materials, we’re the
UK’s most experienced independent foam converter—trusted by procurement teams and engineers in the
[aerospace][58], military, [defence][59], and [industrial][60] sectors.

We don’t just manufacture components—we solve problems. Our expert engineering [team][61], paired
with our full CAD design service, develops specialised foam solutions that meet exact performance,
durability, and environmental requirements. Whether you’re looking for custom foam inserts,
protective foam packaging, or engineered foam parts, we deliver with precision, speed and technical
confidence.

[Find out more][62]

## **Uncompromising on **[**quality**][63]

**Certified to ISO 9001:2015 – because quality can’t be optional**

At Kewell Converters, quality is built into every layer of our process. We operate to [ISO
9001:2015][64] standards, ensuring consistently high-quality foam parts and bespoke foam solutions

This matters most in high-risk sectors like [defence][65] and [aerospace][66], where performance

Managing Director, UK Promotional

## **Engineered for high performance**

**Foam that performs under pressure**

We understand the demands of extreme environments. That’s why our custom foam components are
designed to withstand impact, vibration, temperature extremes, and environmental challenges.

Using advanced foam fabrication techniques and the latest CNC machinery, we manufacture complex foam
parts to precise tolerances – whether it’s a lightweight foam panel, foam gasket, strip, or
protective insert. Our expertise in specialty foams, including Zotefoams and other [branded
foams][68], enables us to match the right material to your performance needs.

[Kewell-Converters-Sustainable-Practice-ISO-14001-Recycle]

## **Sustainable foam manufacturing**

**Smart solutions. Smaller footprint.**

[Sustainability][69] matters — and at Kewell Converters, we act on it. Our processes are certified
to [ISO 14001][70], reflecting our commitment to sustainable foam conversion and responsible
manufacturing.

We continuously optimise our production workflows to minimise waste, maximise material usage, and
reduce energy consumption — without compromising quality. Our goal is to provide manufactured foam
solutions that support your ESG goals without compromising performance.

## **Innovation that solves problems**

Investing in better outcomes for our customers

Innovation is more than a buzzword for us — it’s how we bring ideas to life. From integrating
advanced [CAD][71] and [CNC][72] systems to exploring the latest foam fabrication techniques, we’re
constantly evolving to serve the changing needs of our customers.

Our design-led approach means we collaborate early in the process, offering design for manufacturing
guidance and prototyping to get your solution right first time.

Discover how our innovative thinking has helped customers in your sector on our [case studies][73]
page.

[Our skilled engineers deep in discussion in the factory]

## **Built on trust and integrity**

**A family-run business with a national reputation**

For over five decades, customers have trusted Kewell Converters for honest advice, technical
clarity, and consistent quality. As a family-run company, we’re proud to build long-term
partnerships, not just fulfill orders.

We’re not just here to convert foam — we’re here to make your job easier, your supply chain simpler,
and your product better. Don’t just take our word for it — visit our [Testimonials][74] to see what
our customers have to say.

## Ready to start your foam project?

Let’s talk. Whether you’re looking for bespoke foam parts, a long-term partner for foam fabrication,
or a team that can manage the whole supply chain for you, Kewell Converters is ready to help.

[Contact us][75] today or send an enquiry – and find out how we can add value to your next project.

to provide high-performance foam solutions tailored to the unique demands of various industries,
ensuring reliability and effectiveness in every application. If you’re facing a challenge where the

## We’re Your Nucleus of Support

Whether you’re a manufacturer, architect, builder, engineer, or contractor, when you partner with
NCFI, you gain not just a supplier but a dedicated supporter committed to solving challenges by
cultivating personalized solutions. With a focus on innovation, quality, and comprehensive customer
service, NCFI is there at each stage of the process—from diagnosis to initial planning and
application training to project completion. This hands-on approach allows our partners to enhance
project outcomes, improve sustainability, and increase operational efficiency while having the
confidence of ongoing support and expertise every step of the way.

[Partner With Us][64]

## Our Products

With a focus on producing consistent, reliable materials—including closed-cell spray foam and
open-cell foam—we deliver solutions that meet the highest standards of performance.

### Construction

With decades of experience manufacturing high-performance spray foam insulation (SPF), we prioritize
quality assurance. We’re dedicated to helping you navigate what products your project actually
needs. Together, we can create environments that are safe and energy efficient.
* [InsulBloc ][65]
* [InsulStar ][66]
* [EnduraTech ][67]
* [See All ][68]

### OEM Solutions

We recognize that every product you create has its own unique demands and aesthetic goals. Our
collaborative approach allows us to work closely with you to find the foam that integrates
seamlessly into your designs, ensuring that your products look good and operate at their fullest
potential. Whether you need high-resilience flexible foam or in-plant spray systems, our team is
here to help bring your vision to life.
* [NatureThane ][69]
* [ThermaThane ][70]
* [CryoThane ][71]
* [See All ][72]

### Geotechnical

We understand that challenges like sunken or misaligned concrete slabs can disrupt both residential
and commercial projects, leading to costly repairs and safety concerns. Our geotechnical
polyurethane foams are engineered to provide effective solutions that fit your needs without the
hassle of extensive tear-outs or replacements.

## Essential Resources

Equip yourself with the expertise and insights that make a difference. You’ll always have access to
NCFI’s comprehensive library of resources to browse our equipment inventory, look for a
contractor–or learn how to become one, and compare our spray foam (SPF), OEM, and flexible
polyurethane foams.

Resource HubFor ContractorsEquipment

### Resource Hub

Each resource is crafted to provide detailed insights into product specifications, performance
characteristics, and application techniques, ensuring you have the information necessary to make
informed decisions and execute your projects with confidence.

[Explore our Resources ][77]

### For Contractors

At NCFI, we consider our contractors part of the family and are committed to ensuring that every job
is executed to the highest standards. We know that our foam products are only as good as the
contractors who apply them, which is why we offer comprehensive training programs, both in-classroom
and on-site, to help you and your team become experts in foam application and building science,
along with factory-trained technical support for equipment setup, troubleshooting, and operator
training.

[See the Benefits ][78]

### Equipment

Our team is here to ensure your equipment needs are met with on-site training, troubleshooting, and
ongoing support to keep your projects running smoothly and minimize downtime. NCFI offers a complete
range of high-quality equipment from Graco and PMC for spray polyurethane foam (SPF) and
geotechnical applications. As authorized distributors, we provide everything from plural component
foam spray machines to coating rigs, trailer setups, and custom rigging solutions—backed by full
technical support.

[Find the Right Tools ][79]

## Built for Success

Our case studies highlight our dedication to creating solutions that meet the unique demands of each
project. Working alongside our partners, we evaluate the issue at hand to be able to provide our
expert opinion on how these polyurethane systems should be used and which product fits best. See
real-world examples of our collaboration and specialized support.

[See all Case Studies][80]

## We Have Partnership Down to a Science

Whether you’re looking to learn more about our products and applications or you’re interested in our
professional development opportunities, we’re always here to help.
