# Your Partner in Polyurethane Solutions

For over 60 years, NCFI has reimagined the development of polyurethane foam. With the highest
quality materials and a robust commitment to training and support, we’re proud to be full-service
polyurethane partners to makers around the globe.

[Talk with Us][60]

## NCFI Is A Proud Member of

## Expanding What’s Possible

From picture frames to roofing to seawall repair, and everything in between, polyurethane plays a
vital role in enhancing comfort and performance. At NCFI, we push the boundaries of this technology
to provide high-performance foam solutions tailored to the unique demands of various industries,
ensuring reliability and effectiveness in every application. If you’re facing a challenge where the
ideal product doesn’t exist, our team is ready to innovate and create a solution just for you.

### Construction

We pride ourselves in understanding your project objectives and diagnosing a problem before
recommending a solution. Our rigorous testing and stringent quality standards ensure that you have
the reliability you need for every project phase.
* Residential and Commercial Insulation
* Agricultural Insulation
* Roofing and Coatings

[Let’s Build Together][61]

### OEM Solutions

Our OEM Solutions Group is dedicated to meeting your specific needs with precision and creativity.
Our comprehensive line of products ensures your project team has peace of mind, regardless of the
application.
* Insulated Metal Panels
* Performance and Entry Doors
* Cooler Insulation

[Let’s Create Together ][62]

### Geotechnical

Structural integrity is critical for residential, commercial, and industrial properties. At NCFI, we
understand the urgency of these issues and the need for effective, timely solutions.
* Concrete Leveling
* Soil Stabilization
* Underground Infrastructure Repair

[Let’s Strengthen Together ][63]

## We’re Your Nucleus of Support

Whether you’re a manufacturer, architect, builder, engineer, or contractor, when you partner with
NCFI, you gain not just a supplier but a dedicated supporter committed to solving challenges by
cultivating personalized solutions. With a focus on innovation, quality, and comprehensive customer
service, NCFI is there at each stage of the process—from diagnosis to initial planning and
application training to project completion. This hands-on approach allows our partners to enhance
project outcomes, improve sustainability, and increase operational efficiency while having the
confidence of ongoing support and expertise every step of the way.

[Partner With Us][64]

## Our Products

With a focus on producing consistent, reliable materials—including closed-cell spray foam and
open-cell foam—we deliver solutions that meet the highest standards of performance.

### Construction

With decades of experience manufacturing high-performance spray foam insulation (SPF), we prioritize
quality assurance. We’re dedicated to helping you navigate what products your project actually
needs. Together, we can create environments that are safe and energy efficient.
* [InsulBloc ][65]
* [InsulStar ][66]
* [EnduraTech ][67]
* [See All ][68]

### OEM Solutions

We recognize that every product you create has its own unique demands and aesthetic goals. Our
collaborative approach allows us to work closely with you to find the foam that integrates
seamlessly into your designs, ensuring that your products look good and operate at their fullest
potential. Whether you need high-resilience flexible foam or in-plant spray systems, our team is
here to help bring your vision to life.
* [NatureThane ][69]
* [ThermaThane ][70]
* [CryoThane ][71]
* [See All ][72]

### Geotechnical

We understand that challenges like sunken or misaligned concrete slabs can disrupt both residential
and commercial projects, leading to costly repairs and safety concerns. Our geotechnical
polyurethane foams are engineered to provide effective solutions that fit your needs without the
hassle of extensive tear-outs or replacements.
* [Dual-Component Systems ][73]
* [Light-Weight Fill Systems ][74]
* [Single-Component Hydrophobic ][75]
* [Learn More ][76]

## Essential Resources

Equip yourself with the expertise and insights that make a difference. You’ll always have access to
NCFI’s comprehensive library of resources to browse our equipment inventory, look for a
contractor–or learn how to become one, and compare our spray foam (SPF), OEM, and flexible
polyurethane foams.

Resource HubFor ContractorsEquipment

### Resource Hub

Each resource is crafted to provide detailed insights into product specifications, performance
characteristics, and application techniques, ensuring you have the information necessary to make
informed decisions and execute your projects with confidence.

[Explore our Resources ][77]

### For Contractors

At NCFI, we consider our contractors part of the family and are committed to ensuring that every job
is executed to the highest standards. We know that our foam products are only as good as the
contractors who apply them, which is why we offer comprehensive training programs, both in-classroom
and on-site, to help you and your team become experts in foam application and building science,
along with factory-trained technical support for equipment setup, troubleshooting, and operator
training.

[See the Benefits ][78]

### Equipment

Our team is here to ensure your equipment needs are met with on-site training, troubleshooting, and
ongoing support to keep your projects running smoothly and minimize downtime. NCFI offers a complete
range of high-quality equipment from Graco and PMC for spray polyurethane foam (SPF) and
geotechnical applications. As authorized distributors, we provide everything from plural component
foam spray machines to coating rigs, trailer setups, and custom rigging solutions—backed by full
technical support.

[Find the Right Tools ][79]

## Built for Success

Our case studies highlight our dedication to creating solutions that meet the unique demands of each
project. Working alongside our partners, we evaluate the issue at hand to be able to provide our
expert opinion on how these polyurethane systems should be used and which product fits best. See
real-world examples of our collaboration and specialized support.

[See all Case Studies][80]

## We Have Partnership Down to a Science

Whether you’re looking to learn more about our products and applications or you’re interested in our
professional development opportunities, we’re always here to help.

[Let's Talk Foam][81]

# Premium foam & plastics for USA brands & manufacturers.

Quality, sustainability, and affordability are our most important values. At Pednar Products, we
help our customers & partners succeed by creating custom foam and plastic solutions that meet their
manufacturing needs at the right price point.

## Pednar Foam & Plastic Products

Our vast capabilities include foam rollers, foam pit blocks, foam padding, and custom applications
for consumer goods or industrial applications – especially in fitness centers, gyms, medical
offices, trampoline, and gymnastics parks.

We also specialize in foam pit cubes and pit blocks, foam padding, and foam rollers. You can find a
Pednar product in anything foam and plastic – especially in trampoline and gymnastics parks. We
fabricate high-density gymnastics foam blocks that provide an extra later of safety for
thrill-seekers.

### Some of our specializations:
* Foam Blocks
* Foam Wedges
* Foam Cubes
* Custom Foam Inserts
* Custom Foam Cushions
* Foam Inserts for Boxes
* Laminated Foam
* Foam Packaging Inserts
* Prototyping Foam
* Industrial Packaging Foam
* Foam Gaskets
* Medical Grade Foam
* Foam Insulation
* Foam Seating

[ View All Products ][40]

### Material specializations:

Extruded Foam

Extruded foam is a custom engineered foam product and component for a wide range of markets
including construction, home furnishings, packaging, fitness & recreation, and more. Extrusion is a
continuous high production volume process that typically generates a lower cost per part. Extruded
foam has good mechanical properties and surface finish, especially when compared to fabricated
parts. A variety of in-line and offline converting processes are available, including coated skins
and partial cutting (slitting)

Die-Cut Foam

Whether it is a custom gasket, medical device, retail product, or dunnage and filler, we can
fabricate your parts and components from foam or plastic sheets and rolls.

Lamination/Laminated Foam

Combining layers of foams, foam with plastics or foam with fabrics, we can provide you with a
combination that will suit your needs.

Compression Molded Foam

Shaped foam is used in a wide variety of products and has hundreds of uses. Using compression molds
allows us to replicate your desired shape and material feel for optimum results.

### Foam Rollers

EPP rollers are the benchmark of foam rolling.

10+ stock foam blocks & padding colors.

### Medical Foam

Foam is everywhere in medical & healthcare.

[ Learn More ][43]

### Foam Sponges

Open-cell absorbent sponge material.

## Industries we service:

In sports and recreation, foam padding is a matter of safety – and without foam padding and

Industrial manufacturers, distributors, and production centers require foam products for shock

# Premium foam & plastics for USA brands & manufacturers.

Quality, sustainability, and affordability are our most important values. At Pednar Products, we
help our customers & partners succeed by creating custom foam and plastic solutions that meet their
manufacturing needs at the right price point.

## Pednar Foam & Plastic Products

Our vast capabilities include foam rollers, foam pit blocks, foam padding, and custom applications
for consumer goods or industrial applications – especially in fitness centers, gyms, medical
offices, trampoline, and gymnastics parks.

We also specialize in foam pit cubes and pit blocks, foam padding, and foam rollers. You can find a
Pednar product in anything foam and plastic – especially in trampoline and gymnastics parks. We
fabricate high-density gymnastics foam blocks that provide an extra later of safety for
thrill-seekers.

### Some of our specializations:
* Foam Blocks
* Foam Wedges
* Foam Cubes
* Custom Foam Inserts
* Custom Foam Cushions
* Foam Inserts for Boxes
* Laminated Foam
* Foam Packaging Inserts
* Prototyping Foam
* Industrial Packaging Foam
* Foam Gaskets
* Medical Grade Foam
* Foam Insulation
* Foam Seating

[ View All Products ][40]

### Material specializations:

Extruded Foam

Extruded foam is a custom engineered foam product and component for a wide range of markets
including construction, home furnishings, packaging, fitness & recreation, and more. Extrusion is a
continuous high production volume process that typically generates a lower cost per part. Extruded
foam has good mechanical properties and surface finish, especially when compared to fabricated
parts. A variety of in-line and offline converting processes are available, including coated skins
and partial cutting (slitting)

Die-Cut Foam

Whether it is a custom gasket, medical device, retail product, or dunnage and filler, we can
fabricate your parts and components from foam or plastic sheets and rolls.

Lamination/Laminated Foam

Combining layers of foams, foam with plastics or foam with fabrics, we can provide you with a
combination that will suit your needs.

Compression Molded Foam

Shaped foam is used in a wide variety of products and has hundreds of uses. Using compression molds
allows us to replicate your desired shape and material feel for optimum results.

### Foam Rollers

EPP rollers are the benchmark of foam rolling.

[ Learn More ][41]

### Foam Pit Blocks

10+ stock foam blocks & padding colors.

[ Learn More ][42]

### Medical Foam

Foam is everywhere in medical & healthcare.

[ Learn More ][43]

### Foam Sponges

Open-cell absorbent sponge material.

[ Learn More ][44]

## Industries we service:

foam, expanded polystyrene (EPS), and other materials for insulation, health/medical applications,

that they need to create high-quality, medical-grade products for hospitals, treatment centers, and
specialists. We provide solutions for bedding foam, foam seating, medical-grade foam pads,
medical-grade memory foam, etc.

[ All Industries ][47]

### Sports & Recreation

In sports and recreation, foam padding is a matter of safety – and without foam padding and
protection, many sports and recreational activities would be too dangerous.

[ Learn More ][48]

Pednar products supplies the latest in medical-grade foam as one of the top medical foam fabricators
in Los Angeles County.

[ Learn More ][49]

### Consumer Goods

Every-day common household goods – such as phone cases, purses, apparel, mouse pads, and more are
all manufactured from foam products that Pednar Products has the ability to supply.

[ Learn More ][50]

### Industrial Foam

Industrial manufacturers, distributors, and production centers require foam products for shock
absorbers, insulation, gaskets, cushioning/padding for safety, and more technical applications.

[ Learn More ][51]

### Automotive Foam

Using foam in automotive applications decreases the average density/weight of automobiles, which is
environmentally safer and is a more economic solution for automotive manufacturers.

[ Learn More ][52]

product needs. Pednar Products foam and plastic are manufactured from high-quality materials and are

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Certified to Meet **Your Manufacturing Needs**

[See Our Certifications][22]

## ***Global**
## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Certified to Meet **Your Manufacturing Needs**

[See Our Certifications][22]

## ***Global**
## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

* [Performance Polymer Foam Sponge Production Equipment]
Professional polymer foam sponge materials (EPDM and blend, CR neoprene, NBR / PVC blend, EVA,
Silicone) and products (aerospace, rail transit, new energy materials, automotive electronics,
electronic and electrical accessories) manufacturer, accept OEM, ODM and small volume orders,
provide custom services, welcome to consult and purchase!

## Company Profile:

### Possess Sea is a global leading suppliers of neoprene materials and products. Based on the
### commonality of our own equipment and processes, as well as the needs of downstream customers, we
### have also entered the field of polymer foam sponge materials. We will establish Dongguan Yibao
### Polymer Materials Co., Ltd. in 2021.

### Our company in Shanghai, China is responsible for communicating with international customers and
### handling import and export of related goods (material imports, product exports). Our polymer
### foam sponge materials factory is located in Jinjiang City, Fujian Province, and Dongguan City,
### Guangdong Province, China.

## Company Products:

### Traditionally, we manufacture of "Neoprene Fabric", different kinds of neoprene sponges and
### fabrics from different countries or regions are used to combine them into different grades and
### types of "Neoprene Fabric" according to the needs of customers. It is supplied to its own
### finished product department and widely sold to manufacturing companies around the world.

### Now in addition to the traditional CR neoprene and SBR foam materials, we also manufacture
### various types of EPDM, NBR, PVC, EVA, Silicone and other polymer foam sponge materials, and
### blends, combinations and modifications of these materials. And provide customers with rough
### processing (slicing / cutting) services for these materials, and cooperate with various
### downstream factory to do finishing (die cutting / forming) services to meet the needs of various
### traditional / new energy vehicle companies and electronic / electrical appliances factory.

## Company Services:

### Our company has import and export rights and rich experience, can directly apply for a
### certificate of origin (CCPIT or Customs). In addition to ordering our products, we can also help
### international customers to purchase other Chinese products, handle export procedures, and
### arrange transportation services (express, air, sea).

### For polymer foam sponge materials, in addition to providing sponge block and slicing / cutting
### services, we also provide customers with die cutting / forming services, and can customize the
### production (blends, combinations and modifications) of foam materials with various physical
### properties according to customer requirements to meet different needs.

batteries. Our [materials][73] offer excellent fire resistance, thermal insulation, and structural
support for battery pack applications. Our [precision fabrication services][74] ensure exact
specifications for battery safety components.

PYG laminated sheets offer a variety of solutions for a wide range of packaging inserts. PYG foams
feature excellent [thermal insulation][75], good water resistance properties, low vapor
permeability, and high chemical resistance making them the ideal [material for electronics
protection][76]. Our [die cutting and CNC milling services][77] create exact-fit electronic
components.

in wide variety of colors, thus being the top [material][78] for camping and insulation mats,
insoles, body protectors, backpacks, swimming suits, safety jackets etc. Our [custom fabrication
services][79] can create tailored packaging solutions for your specific needs.

## Rapid Delivery. Reliable supply. Trusted by industries worldwide for premium foam solutions.

[ Our Materials ][43]
[ Our Capabilities ][44]

##### We are Ramfoam

### Europe's Leading
### Polyethylene Foam
### Supplier

With next-day delivery available on selected blocks and one of the fastest turnaround times in the
industry, Ramfoam keeps your production moving without delay. As Europe’s largest stockist and
supplier of premium cross-linked polyethylene foam and the world’s largest global supplier of
Zotefoams materials, we combine scale with precision and reliability. We’re trusted by converters
and manufacturers across multiple industries for the consistent quality of our materials and our
customer-first approach, ensuring you get the right foam, on time, and ready to perform.

[ Find out More ][45]

## Commited To Quality...

#### Materials

Ramfoam supplies a complete range of premium foam materials, from cross-linked and non-cross-linked
polyethylene to reticulated polyurethane, and many more. Serving industries from leisure and retail
to medical and automotive, we provide the ideal material for every tailored requirement.

supply of polyethylene and polyurethane foam to ensure every product is manufactured
cost-effectively and to the highest quality standards.

## Industries

With an abundance of experience supporting multiple sectors, we proudly support clients across the
UK and internationally, delivering fast, efficient, and quality-driven solutions tailored to the
needs of diverse industries.

Ramfoam’s position as the world’s largest distributor of Zotefoams materials means we can deliver
faster, more reliably, and at greater scale than anyone else. With extensive stock held on-site and
a dedicated logistics team, we keep production running smoothly while maintaining Zotefoams’
renowned quality and consistency.

# Offering Innovative Technical Solutions Across a Wide Range of Industries

As a 3M™ Preferred Converter and authorized distributor of [3M][91], [Aearo Technologies][92], and
[Laird][93], Rathbun is your trusted source for thermal management, vibration damping, energy
control, and more. We supply adhesives, fasteners, foams, bushings, and other custom solutions to
numerous fields, including electronics, semiconductors, [military][94], audio, biotech, [LED
lighting][95], medical, and beyond.

Based in Fremont, California, we serve clients in the [San Francisco Bay Area][96], Silicon Valley,
nationwide, and around the globe.

## CONFOR™ Foams by Aearo Technologies, a 3M company

CONFOR™ Foams deliver controlled cushioning and superior shock absorption to protect sensitive
components in demanding environments. Their temperature-responsive design helps minimize impact and
vibration in electronic, industrial, medical, and aircraft applications. Available in M, EG, TF, and
AC Series to support a wide range of industries.

[Learn More][97]

## 3M Materials

Rathbun is a certified converter and distributor of 3M products. Our extensive 3M catalog includes
thermal, adhesives, VHB, and more. Providing customizable options and manufacturing services to
match, our converting experts will find the best solution to meet your needs and deliver the most
effective solution for your application.

# Offering Innovative Technical Solutions Across a Wide Range of Industries

As a 3M™ Preferred Converter and authorized distributor of [3M][91], [Aearo Technologies][92], and
[Laird][93], Rathbun is your trusted source for thermal management, vibration damping, energy
control, and more. We supply adhesives, fasteners, foams, bushings, and other custom solutions to
numerous fields, including electronics, semiconductors, [military][94], audio, biotech, [LED
lighting][95], medical, and beyond.

Based in Fremont, California, we serve clients in the [San Francisco Bay Area][96], Silicon Valley,
nationwide, and around the globe.

## CONFOR™ Foams by Aearo Technologies, a 3M company

CONFOR™ Foams deliver controlled cushioning and superior shock absorption to protect sensitive
components in demanding environments. Their temperature-responsive design helps minimize impact and
vibration in electronic, industrial, medical, and aircraft applications. Available in M, EG, TF, and
AC Series to support a wide range of industries.

[Learn More][97]

## 3M Materials

Rathbun is a certified converter and distributor of 3M products. Our extensive 3M catalog includes
thermal, adhesives, VHB, and more. Providing customizable options and manufacturing services to
match, our converting experts will find the best solution to meet your needs and deliver the most
effective solution for your application.

## Laird Gap Fillers & Thermal Interface Materials

Laird gap fillers and thermal interface materials keep delicate electronics from overheating during
normal operations. Laird’s high-quality products offer advanced protection for most electronic
components, parts, or systems.

[Learn More][123]

## Custom Converting Services

Rathbun strives to provide advanced solutions for your most challenging problems. Utilizing our
expertise in materials and manufacturing, we can create premium-quality results customized to your
application requirements.

Each part is tested for functionality, dimensional accuracy, and environmental performance,
including any applicable governmental and industrial regulations. We are able to design customized
products for your application using in-house converting capabilities that you can rely on.

#### Our Converting Services Include:

[Laser Cutting][124] [Die Cutting][125] [Rotary Die Cutting][126] [Lamination][127] [Kiss
Cutting][128] [Slitting & Rewinding][129]

We value you and your business. We are committed to providing our customers with the best service
available in the industry from our California headquarters. Our friendly staff will answer your
call, ready to help you, without automated menus or long hold times. Choosing the right solution for
your application is what we do at Rathbun.

Place your order today, request a quote, or contact us for more information on our premium quality
products and services.

## Renewable Carbon by nova-Institute

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

[Subscribe]

### Renewable Carbon Newsletters

Stay informed about the latest developments in the renewable carbon industry and nova-Institute’s
activities. Choose the news relevant to your business out of 19 different topics: sustainability –
renewable carbon – recycling – policy – pharma – natural fibres – food – engineering – energy –
digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –
plastics and composites – bio-based chemicals and industrial biotechnology – automotive –
agriculture, forestry and resources – nova’s monthly newsletter – Renewable Carbon Newsletter –
Press releases – events and conferences.

[**https://renewable-carbon.eu/newsletters**][38]

[Businesses Directory]

### ReCaCo – International Directory for Renewable Materials

The leading business directory for the bio-based, CO2-based and recycled materials gives you the
opportunity to look up suppliers, partners and service providers or present your own company and
products to the right audience for you.

[https://renewable-carbon.eu/companies/][39]

[nova-Institute]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

### Renewable Carbon News

# Welcome to the world of Shadow Foam

Shadow Foam is the ultimate toolbox organiser. Used to **organise** and **protect** your hand tools,
power tools, camera gear and much more into a bespoke foam insert. If you’ve ever been stressed
searching for a tool, or felt the pain of replacing a broken piece of equipment… then Shadow Foam is
for you.

Made from 100% polyethylene, and designed with a unique structure that allows the foam to cut
cleanly and peel easily. This allows anyone to create **professional-level** toolbox foam inserts.
Unlike Kaizen Foam, Shadow Foam is available in 9 colours and a wide range of sizes.

## Informational Links

[Are you an Educator or Student?][35]

Smooth-On works with teachers and students at colleges and universities to educate people on how
liquid rubbers, plastics, foams and other materials can be used for an infinite number of
applications.

[› Read more][36]
[Need a Mold or Casting Made?][37]

For those of you interested in having molds or castings made for you, we are pleased to suggest a
list of professional mold makers and casters who can do it for you.

[› Read more][38]
[Looking for Custom Formulations?][39]

Our chemists have many years of combined experience and are respected industry wide for their
individual expertise and development capability. There are minimum volume requirements for
manufacturing a custom formulation and we will be happy to discuss this and other variables to
determine what is possible.

[› Read more][40]

###### About Smooth-On, Inc.

You may never have heard of us, but you've seen our products at work. If you've ever been to the
movies, admired a piece of sculpture, marveled at detailed architectural ornamentation or used a
telephone; then you've encountered the handiwork of people who use Smooth-On rubbers, plastics,
foams and other products to turn their ideas into 3-dimensional reality.

**WHO WE ARE:**

## About Specialty Products, Inc.

[Specialty Products, Inc.] For more than 40 years, Specialty Products, Inc. (SPI) has put our name
and reputation on the line. Our relentless dedication to advancing the protective coating and
insulation industries by providing high-performance products, and continuing education platforms,
has made us a global market leader. Operating under the original owners and leadership, our products
come with the same reliability and innovation today, as they did decades ago.

We select only the highest quality raw materials, invest in the latest production technologies,
apply the best business practices, and when combined, create an exceptional buying experience for
our customers. SPI’s ever-evolving and expanding product line includes polyurea, polyurethane foams,
geo-technical foams, coatings, primers, spray equipment and parts.

Our unique testing environment allows our chemists to rapidly develop and test product variations to
ensure you have a product formulated with the exact physical properties to meet your individual
project needs.

We take immense pride in our well-trained field representatives, technical support team, chemical
engineers, production force, customer service personnel, and education instructors.  SPI provides
our customers with the highest level of technical knowledge in the protective coatings and
polyurethane foam industries. We offer 24/7 technical support, from a staff with a combined total of
250 years of expertise.

Headquartered in Lakewood, WA USA, SPI has remote operation centers in Rowlett, TX – Chicago, IL –
Anchorage, AK and distributors & agents strategically located around the world. SPI is your trusted
source for polyurea coatings, polyurethane foam systems and plural-component spray application
equipment.

SPI is a founding member of the Polyurea Development Association (PDA).

**WHO WE ARE:**

## About Specialty Products, Inc.

[Specialty Products, Inc.] For more than 40 years, Specialty Products, Inc. (SPI) has put our name
and reputation on the line. Our relentless dedication to advancing the protective coating and
insulation industries by providing high-performance products, and continuing education platforms,
has made us a global market leader. Operating under the original owners and leadership, our products
come with the same reliability and innovation today, as they did decades ago.

We select only the highest quality raw materials, invest in the latest production technologies,
apply the best business practices, and when combined, create an exceptional buying experience for
our customers. SPI’s ever-evolving and expanding product line includes polyurea, polyurethane foams,
geo-technical foams, coatings, primers, spray equipment and parts.

Our unique testing environment allows our chemists to rapidly develop and test product variations to
ensure you have a product formulated with the exact physical properties to meet your individual
project needs.

We take immense pride in our well-trained field representatives, technical support team, chemical
engineers, production force, customer service personnel, and education instructors.  SPI provides
our customers with the highest level of technical knowledge in the protective coatings and
polyurethane foam industries. We offer 24/7 technical support, from a staff with a combined total of
250 years of expertise.

Headquartered in Lakewood, WA USA, SPI has remote operation centers in Rowlett, TX – Chicago, IL –
Anchorage, AK and distributors & agents strategically located around the world. SPI is your trusted
source for polyurea coatings, polyurethane foam systems and plural-component spray application
equipment.

SPI is a founding member of the Polyurea Development Association (PDA).

### See How Flexible Polyurethane Foam is Made

[Watch Our New Video][59]

Open cell, flexible polyurethane foam (FPF) is a polymer material used in residential and commercial
furnishings, automotive interiors, carpet underlay and in hundreds of industrial, medical, packaging
and technical applications. More than 1.5 billion pounds of flexible polyurethane foam are produced
in North America each year.

The Polyurethane Foam Association represents FPF manufacturers and suppliers to the  industry. PFA
funds research on critical industry topics, provides members with tools for regulatory compliance,
and educates members on market trends. Our Technical Program serves as a forum for novel chemical
formulations, the latest equipment, and best practices in manufacturing, testing, EHS and
sustainability.

[****][60]

### Key Markets For Flexible Polyurethane Foam

[][61]

#### [Furniture][62]

Flexible polyurethane foam is used in upholstered furniture, office furniture, and other
applications. Foam is a key component for delivering comfort and style.

[][63]

#### [Mattresses][64]

Mattresses may contain layers of foam with innersprings, or the entire mattress could be made from
foam. Special foam formulations such as viscoelastic foam (memory foam) are designed specifically
for mattress applications.

[][65]

#### [Transportation][66]

In automobilies, flexible polyurethane foam is used for seats, headliners, dash and door padding and
sound/vibration dampening. Many products use molded foam technology to create unique shapes and
performance attributes.

[][67]

#### [Carpet Cushion][68]

Flexible polyurethane is a dominant material  in carpet cushion, with much of it recycled from
industrial or consumer applications. Bonded foam carpet cushion provides comfort and protects carpet
from wear.

[][69]

#### [Medical][70]

Flexible polyurethane foam is used in medical applications ranging from bandages to cushions and
supports, to medical equipment.

[][71]

#### [Speciality and Household][72]

Flexible polyurethane foam is used in scores of products around the home, from sponges to clothing
to toys.

Of Flexible Polyurethane Foam

The latest on issues, events, and individuals impacting the flexible polyurethane foam industry.

[][58]

### See How Flexible Polyurethane Foam is Made

[Watch Our New Video][59]

Open cell, flexible polyurethane foam (FPF) is a polymer material used in residential and commercial
furnishings, automotive interiors, carpet underlay and in hundreds of industrial, medical, packaging
and technical applications. More than 1.5 billion pounds of flexible polyurethane foam are produced
in North America each year.

The Polyurethane Foam Association represents FPF manufacturers and suppliers to the  industry. PFA
funds research on critical industry topics, provides members with tools for regulatory compliance,
and educates members on market trends. Our Technical Program serves as a forum for novel chemical
formulations, the latest equipment, and best practices in manufacturing, testing, EHS and
sustainability.

[****][60]

### Key Markets For Flexible Polyurethane Foam

[][61]

#### [Furniture][62]

Flexible polyurethane foam is used in upholstered furniture, office furniture, and other
applications. Foam is a key component for delivering comfort and style.

[][63]

#### [Mattresses][64]

Mattresses may contain layers of foam with innersprings, or the entire mattress could be made from
foam. Special foam formulations such as viscoelastic foam (memory foam) are designed specifically
for mattress applications.

[][65]

#### [Transportation][66]

In automobilies, flexible polyurethane foam is used for seats, headliners, dash and door padding and
sound/vibration dampening. Many products use molded foam technology to create unique shapes and
performance attributes.

[][67]

#### [Carpet Cushion][68]

Flexible polyurethane is a dominant material  in carpet cushion, with much of it recycled from
industrial or consumer applications. Bonded foam carpet cushion provides comfort and protects carpet
from wear.

[][69]

#### [Medical][70]

Flexible polyurethane foam is used in medical applications ranging from bandages to cushions and
supports, to medical equipment.

[][71]

#### [Speciality and Household][72]

Flexible polyurethane foam is used in scores of products around the home, from sponges to clothing
to toys.

# The Vita Group acquires Technical Foam Services
* [30 September 2025November 19, 2025][163]

[Image]

**Middleton, UK, July 5, 2021** – The Vita Group (or “Vita”), Europe’s leading flexible foam
solutions provider, has announced the acquisition of Technical Foam Services (TFS), a UK foam
conversion business based in Corby.

TFS will bring enhanced technical foam conversion capacity and capability to The Vita Group, as well
as bringing an even greater level of service and access to product and conversion expertise for
customers.

Stuart Roby (left), MD at The Vita Group, and Duncan Geddes, MD at Technical Foam Services

With over 50 people employed at its site in Corby, Northants, TFS has been providing a range of
bespoke, high-quality foams to several market sectors, including the automotive, medical, audio and
retail industries, for more than 20 years. Duncan Geddes, owner and Managing Director of TFS, will
continue to lead the business following the acquisition.

Duncan commented: “The integration of Technical Foam Services into The Vita Group is an exciting
development and will allow us to continue providing our customers with the highest levels of service
and be uniquely placed to offer customers additional value-added solutions.”

TFS is the first UK foam converter to achieve all three International Organisation for
Standardisation (ISO) standards for prioritising the health and wellness of staff, delivery of
high-quality products and for its approach to environmental consciousness.

Speaking on behalf of The Vita Group, Group CEO Ian Robb said: “We believe this transaction allows
Vita to provide a broader range of services and products, as well as the potential for opening up
new routes to market. Duncan is a highly respected leader in the industry and with his experienced
workforce has built an impressive entrepreneurial company in TFS.  We look forward to working
together in the future to support our customers.”

**– ENDS –**

**For more information and interview requests please contact**:

Laura Harris – Influential PR
[harris@thisisinfluential.com][164]

Sarah Probert-Hill – Corporate Marketing & PR Manager
[sarah.probert-hill@thevitagroup.com][165]

Stuart Roby – Managing Director Technical Division
[stuart.roby@thevitagroup.com][166]

**About Technical Foam Services (TFS)**

Based in Corby, Northants, UK, TFS combine cutting-edge engineering and foam conversion processes
with a dedication to quality and complete customer satisfaction, TFS are the first UK foam converter
to achieve all three International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO) standards. They have been
awarded the standards for prioritising the health and wellness of staff, delivery of high-quality
products and for their approach to environmental consciousness.

**About The Vita Group**

The Vita Group is Europe’s leading flexible foam solutions provider. Built on 70 years of heritage,
Vita develops, manufactures, and markets a wide range of value-added and differentiated flexible
polyurethane foam and Talalay latex and flooring products.

Vita’s three divisions – Comfort, Technical and Flooring – cater for customers across a broad set of
industries including Bed-in-the-Box mattresses and bedding, furniture, hygiene and medical,
mobility, construction, and flooring. The company’s pan-European operating base is well-positioned
to serve local, regional, and multi-national customers across Europe and provide innovative and
value-added products and applications across the world.

Vita has responded to the urgent need for products and materials to support healthcare, care homes,
medical and hygiene applications during the COVID-19 emergency.  The Company is currently delivering
products for medical mattresses, filters for ventilators, PPE mask inserts, and many other
healthcare relate products. For more information, please visit [www.thevitagroup.com][167]

# The Vita Group acquires Technical Foam Services
* [30 September 2025November 19, 2025][163]

[Image]

**Middleton, UK, July 5, 2021** – The Vita Group (or “Vita”), Europe’s leading flexible foam
solutions provider, has announced the acquisition of Technical Foam Services (TFS), a UK foam
conversion business based in Corby.

TFS will bring enhanced technical foam conversion capacity and capability to The Vita Group, as well
as bringing an even greater level of service and access to product and conversion expertise for
customers.

Stuart Roby (left), MD at The Vita Group, and Duncan Geddes, MD at Technical Foam Services

With over 50 people employed at its site in Corby, Northants, TFS has been providing a range of
bespoke, high-quality foams to several market sectors, including the automotive, medical, audio and
retail industries, for more than 20 years. Duncan Geddes, owner and Managing Director of TFS, will
continue to lead the business following the acquisition.

Duncan commented: “The integration of Technical Foam Services into The Vita Group is an exciting
development and will allow us to continue providing our customers with the highest levels of service
and be uniquely placed to offer customers additional value-added solutions.”

TFS is the first UK foam converter to achieve all three International Organisation for
Standardisation (ISO) standards for prioritising the health and wellness of staff, delivery of
high-quality products and for its approach to environmental consciousness.

Speaking on behalf of The Vita Group, Group CEO Ian Robb said: “We believe this transaction allows
Vita to provide a broader range of services and products, as well as the potential for opening up
new routes to market. Duncan is a highly respected leader in the industry and with his experienced
workforce has built an impressive entrepreneurial company in TFS.  We look forward to working
together in the future to support our customers.”

**– ENDS –**

**For more information and interview requests please contact**:

Laura Harris – Influential PR
[harris@thisisinfluential.com][164]

Sarah Probert-Hill – Corporate Marketing & PR Manager
[sarah.probert-hill@thevitagroup.com][165]

Stuart Roby – Managing Director Technical Division
[stuart.roby@thevitagroup.com][166]

**About Technical Foam Services (TFS)**

Based in Corby, Northants, UK, TFS combine cutting-edge engineering and foam conversion processes
with a dedication to quality and complete customer satisfaction, TFS are the first UK foam converter
to achieve all three International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO) standards. They have been
awarded the standards for prioritising the health and wellness of staff, delivery of high-quality
products and for their approach to environmental consciousness.

**About The Vita Group**

The Vita Group is Europe’s leading flexible foam solutions provider. Built on 70 years of heritage,
Vita develops, manufactures, and markets a wide range of value-added and differentiated flexible
polyurethane foam and Talalay latex and flooring products.

Vita’s three divisions – Comfort, Technical and Flooring – cater for customers across a broad set of
industries including Bed-in-the-Box mattresses and bedding, furniture, hygiene and medical,
mobility, construction, and flooring. The company’s pan-European operating base is well-positioned
to serve local, regional, and multi-national customers across Europe and provide innovative and
value-added products and applications across the world.

Vita has responded to the urgent need for products and materials to support healthcare, care homes,
medical and hygiene applications during the COVID-19 emergency.  The Company is currently delivering
products for medical mattresses, filters for ventilators, PPE mask inserts, and many other
healthcare relate products. For more information, please visit [www.thevitagroup.com][167]

# Top Quality Products for Top Quality Customers

##### All of us at Thermal Foams wish to thank all of you for your continued support over the years.
##### It’s been your trust and confidence that has helped us achieve our goals of providing our
##### customers with only top quality products, at fair, competitive prices and unsurpassed personal
##### and professional service. Thank you for your business!

#### Learn more about the quality products we offer:

#### Tru-R Insulation

##### Your Solution, Whatever Your Needs

Thermal Foams is the leader in providing products for construction, geotechnical, industrial, and
packaging applications. Tru-R is a lightweight yet strong material that gives architects, designers
and builders the freedom and confidence to turn their visions into reality.

[Learn More][15]

#### Tru-R Geofoam

##### Lightweight Fill Material

Traditional earth materials are heavy and can cause settlement, instability or lateral pressures.
Other fill materials such as foamed concrete, waste tires, soil, woodchips, wood fiber, etc., have
higher densities and are not engineered. Tru-R Geofoam solves all these problems.

[Learn More][16]

#### Protective Packaging

##### Design. Shape. Cushion. Protect. You’re in control.

Tru-R provides the thermal, cushioning, strength and lightweight qualities that enhance your
product’s performance at the right price. By shaping the material, we can incorporate a precision
fit with proven packaging techniques to attain the highest level of protection.

[Learn More][17]

#### How can you participate in sustainability?

All of our Tru-R products are 100% recyclable and we offer a drop off recycling service to our
customers and the local community. We accept clean white Expanded Polystyrene only, no food
containers or packaging peanuts. Material can be dropped off at our Buffalo NY location Monday –
Friday 8:30am – 3:30pm. When you arrive, please check into the office for instructions on where to
leave the material.

# The Vita Group is a leading provider of innovative and flexible Polyurethane (PU) Foam products,
# high-end Talalay latex offerings, flooring solutions and advanced materials

[ Explore Foam Solutions ][161]

## What makes us different

Our commitment to sustainability drives our continuous growth in industry leadership. By leveraging
our cutting-edge technology and state-of-the-art innovation centres, we empower our customers to
develop their own groundbreaking products.

[ Our Company ][162]
[icon][icon]

Leading the transformation in the industry, harnessing advanced material science to drive
sustainability and innovation.

[icon][icon]

4 State-of-the-Art Innovation Centres across UK & Europe enabling us to tailor products to meet
specific market needs.

[icon][icon]

32 strategically located facilities across Europe, enabling us to effectively and efficiently reach
our customers globally.

[icon][icon]

We are a leading innovator with over 75 years of experience in advanced material solutions.

## Our Business Units

We have 4 strategic Business Units formed to meet customers needs and represent the best in foam
innovation, technology and expertise.

[Image][Image]

### Furniture and Bedding

Flexible PU Foam Solutions for Furniture and Bedding, aimed at enhancing comfort, whilst maintaining
durability.

[ Furniture u0026 Bedding ][163]
[Image][Image]

### Finished Mattress

Flexible PU Foam Solutions for Finished Mattress, from concept to finished product.

[ Finished Mattress ][164]
[Image][Image]

### Engineered Solutions

Driving innovation across multiple industries – from Aviation and Filtration to EVs, and beyond, by
leveraging advanced capabilities in functional foams, custom engineering and converting.

[ Engineered Solutions ][165]
[Image][Image]

### Flooring

Underlay Solutions for Flooring, including for carpet, wood, laminate and artificial turf.

[ Flooring ][166]

### Driving Circularity

Driving Circularity is key to a sustainable future. It enhances product reusability, recyclability,
and durability, reducing waste and conserving resources.

[ Find Out More ][167]

### Optimising Resources

Optimising resources is important for us, not only because it makes good business sense, but also
because it is the right thing to do.

[ Find Out More ][168]

### Empowering People

Our drive to innovate is powered by our people; their passion and commitment are our greatest
assets. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, supportive workplace that prioritises health,
safety, and continuous development.

[ Find Out More ][169]

### Acting Ethically

Acting ethically is rooted in The Vita Group’s core values of integrity and responsibility. This
means minimising our negative environmental and social impact, enhancing local communities, and
making the right choices, even when they are difficult.

[ Find Out More ][170]

[ Explore Foam Solutions ][161]

## What makes us different

Our commitment to sustainability drives our continuous growth in industry leadership. By leveraging
our cutting-edge technology and state-of-the-art innovation centres, we empower our customers to
develop their own groundbreaking products.

[ Our Company ][162]
[icon][icon]

Leading the transformation in the industry, harnessing advanced material science to drive
sustainability and innovation.

[icon][icon]

4 State-of-the-Art Innovation Centres across UK & Europe enabling us to tailor products to meet
specific market needs.

[icon][icon]

32 strategically located facilities across Europe, enabling us to effectively and efficiently reach
our customers globally.

[icon][icon]

We are a leading innovator with over 75 years of experience in advanced material solutions.

## Our Business Units

We have 4 strategic Business Units formed to meet customers needs and represent the best in foam
innovation, technology and expertise.

[Image][Image]

### Furniture and Bedding

Flexible PU Foam Solutions for Furniture and Bedding, aimed at enhancing comfort, whilst maintaining
durability.

[ Furniture u0026 Bedding ][163]
[Image][Image]

### Finished Mattress

Flexible PU Foam Solutions for Finished Mattress, from concept to finished product.

[ Finished Mattress ][164]
[Image][Image]

### Engineered Solutions

Driving innovation across multiple industries – from Aviation and Filtration to EVs, and beyond, by
leveraging advanced capabilities in functional foams, custom engineering and converting.

[ Engineered Solutions ][165]
[Image][Image]

### Flooring

Underlay Solutions for Flooring, including for carpet, wood, laminate and artificial turf.

[ Flooring ][166]

### Driving Circularity

Driving Circularity is key to a sustainable future. It enhances product reusability, recyclability,
and durability, reducing waste and conserving resources.

[ Find Out More ][167]

### Optimising Resources

Optimising resources is important for us, not only because it makes good business sense, but also
because it is the right thing to do.

[ Find Out More ][168]

### Empowering People

Our drive to innovate is powered by our people; their passion and commitment are our greatest
assets. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, supportive workplace that prioritises health,
safety, and continuous development.

[ Find Out More ][169]

### Acting Ethically

Acting ethically is rooted in The Vita Group’s core values of integrity and responsibility. This
means minimising our negative environmental and social impact, enhancing local communities, and
making the right choices, even when they are difficult.

[ Find Out More ][170]

# Towards Packaging Analytics & Consulting: Shaping Tomorrow’s Packaging Industry Insights

With a relentless commitment to providing actionable insights, we stand at the forefront of the
global packaging industry. Navigating the intricate tapestry of the packaging market, we consult and
deliver comprehensive market analysis.

[ Read More [next-arrow] ][18]
[ Read More ][19]
[banner-top]

## Latest Insights

### [ Stainless Steel Containers Market Size & Trends 2026-2035 ][20]

The stainless steel containers market valued at USD 16.8 billion in 2025, is anticipated to reach
USD 32.13 billion by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 6.7% over the next decade.

[ Read More about "Stainless Steel Containers Market Size & Trends 2026-2035" ][21]

### [ PTP Aluminum Foil for Pharmaceutical Package Market Size & Trends 2025-2035 ][22]

The PTP aluminum foil for pharmaceutical package market is forecast to increase from USD 904.00
million in 2025 to USD 1,573.69 million by 2035, at a CAGR of 5.7%.

[ Read More about "PTP Aluminum Foil for Pharmaceutical Package Market Size & Trends 2025-2035"
][23]

### [ Tire Packaging Film Market Size and Trends 2025-35 ][24]

The tire packaging film market is forecast to increase from USD 648.00 million in 2025 to USD
1,310.91 million by 2035, at a CAGR of 7.3%.

[ Read More about "Tire Packaging Film Market Size and Trends 2025-35" ][25]

### [ Thermoformed Food Packaging Trays Market Report 2025-35 ][26]

The thermoformed food packaging trays market is forecast to increase from USD 5.80 billion in 2025
to USD 12.07 billion by 2035, at a CAGR of 7.6%.

[ Read More about "Thermoformed Food Packaging Trays Market Report 2025-35" ][27]

## Market Penetration

We offer over 100 comprehensive reports focused on sustainable packaging and related markets. Our
reports cover the latest innovations, trends, and regulatory updates, providing businesses with
up-to-date data and actionable insights. Stay informed on emerging solutions, market dynamics, and
growth opportunities in the rapidly evolving sustainable packaging industry.

[Explore About Sustainable Packaging [next-arrow] ][36]

## Why Choose Towards Packaging Analytics & Consulting

[Learn about Towards Packaging Analytics & Consulting [next-arrow] ][37]
[customer-insights]

### Actionable Insights

Gain valuable, data-driven insights backed by thorough research and market trends, empowering
businesses to make informed, strategic decisions for sustainable growth in packaging sector.

[market-databook]

### Market Databook

Access in-depth, interactive databooks filled with essential data, trends, and forecasts, helping
you analyze packaging market performance and predict future shifts with precision

[company-profiles]

### Competitive Landscape

Explore detailed profiles of leading packaging companies, including financials, strategies, market
positioning, and key innovations, to benchmark competitors and identify new opportunities.

[segmental-analysis]

### Segmental Analysis

Gain an in-depth understanding of specific packaging market segments, uncovering key trends,
consumer preferences, and growth drivers across product categories, applications, and industries.

[market-share-analysis]

### Geographical Analysis

Explore regional variations in the packaging market, identifying emerging opportunities, local
demand patterns, and regulatory impacts across different geographies for more precise market
targeting.

## You’re in Good Company

Towards Packaging Analytics & Consulting has been an invaluable resource for our business. The
in-depth market reports and data-driven insights have helped us make more informed decisions about
our packaging strategies. Their comprehensive analysis of industry trends, material innovations, and
sustainability practices has kept us ahead of the competition. We highly recommend their services to
anyone looking for reliable and actionable market research in the packaging industry.

We have been consistently impressed with the quality of insights provided by Towards Packaging
Analytics & Consulting. Their reports are detailed, up-to-date, and tailored to meet our business
needs. The expert analysis has helped us understand evolving market dynamics and refine our
packaging solutions for better customer engagement. A great partner for any packaging-focused
company!

system charakteryzuje się mało uciążliwym zapachem podczas natryskiwania.. Klasa palności E.

Wewnętrzne: Ultrapol RG 03/35

**RG 03/35**
**Gęstość po natryśnięciu ok 40 kg/m3**

Charakteryzuje się wysoką twardością w stosunku do gęstości a także gładkim licem. Ze względu na
wysoką zawartość Solkane 365/227 posiada bardzo dobre właściwości izolacyjne. Jest też odporny na
skurcz a zarazem pękanie piany w różnych temperaturach. Klasa palności E.

Posadzkowe: Ultrapol RG 05/55p

**RG 05/55p**
**Gęstość po natryśnięciu ok 50 kg/m3**

System stworzony do izolacji fundamentów. Ekonomiczna wersja systemu dachowego o zmniejszonej
gęstości i odporności na ogień przy utrzymaniu wysokiej wytrzymałości na ściskanie.

Dachowe: Ultrapol RG 05/55

**RG 05/55**
**Gęstość po natryśnięciu ok 60 kg/m3**

Charakteryzuję się bardzo wysoka twardością a także bardzo gładkim licem, co jest istotne podczas
zabezpieczenia piany farbą. Ze względu na wysoką zawartość Solkane 365/227 posiada bardzo dobre
właściwości izolacyjne. Jest też odporny na skurcz a zarazem pękanie piany.

Bardzo twarde: Ultrapol RG 05/500

**RG 05/500**
**Gęstość po natryśnięciu ok 600 kg/m3**

System jest prawie nie spieniony o bardzo twardej strukturze i doskonale nadaje się do wzmacniania
elementów z ABS i PMMA

## Poliuretanowych

Spółka Ultrapur powstała w 2013 roku. Jest aktualnie prowadzona i zarządzana przez ludzi
posiadających wieloletnie doświadczenie w branży poliuretanowej. Nasze motto to stwórz i wyprodukuj

[[przewiń]][38]

# Spółka Ultrapur powstała w 2013 roku

Aktualnie zatrudnione osoby w firmie posiadają wieloletnie doświadczenie w branży poliuretanowej i
są specjalistami w zakresie tworzenia, produkcji i wdrażania u klienta dopasowanych do jego potrzeb
produktów.

25 lat

Bij UXEM zitten we graag samen met onze klant aan tafel om de maakbaarheid van een ontwerp te
bepalen en optimaliseren.

Je kunt het zo gek niet bedenken, wij denken graag met je mee. Wij helpen ook in een vroeg stadium
van ideevorming, van ontwerp tot uiteindelijke productiewijze.

specifieke wensen

## Veelgestelde **vragen**

### Leveren jullie ook aan particuliere klanten?

UXEM levert helaas alleen aan bedrijven. Voor particulieren klanten hebben wij wel 2 webshops waar
je platen kunt bestellen. Zie www.redux.nl en www.uxfoam.nl

### Hoe zit het met de afwerking van producten?

Naast de vormingstechnieken zoals 2D computergestuurd snijden, stansen, frezen, 3D snijden,
thermoformen, werken wij het schuim desgewenst af door het te lamineren, verlijmen of coaten, evt
met een zelfklevende laag, PU-film, non-woven, klittenband of haakband.

### Hoe weet ik welk materiaal geschikt is voor mijn toepassing?

Graag adviseren we je over alle mogelijke schuimen die geschikt zijn voor een technische toepassing.
Wij hebben 50 jaar ervaring met het produceren en verwerken van alle flexibele kunststofschuimen,
voor zeer veel diverse toepassingen. Neem gerust contact met ons op om een afspraak te maken.

### Wat zijn de gemiddelde levertijden?

De gemiddelde levertijd voor maatwerkproducten ligt tussen de 2-4 weken. Afhankelijk van de
aantallen, het gekozen materiaal, de bewerkingen etc. Neem gerust contact met ons op voor meer
informatie.

### Kan ik ook langskomen?

Uiteraard. Wij verwelkomen je heel graag in Lelystad. In onze showroom kunnen wij alle materialen en
bewerkingen laten zien en zo optimaal advies geven over de beste keuze qua materiaal, maakbaarheid
en kosten. Klik op “maak een afspraak” onder contact.

## Welcome to VeeChem Global

VeeChem is a diverse and fast-growing company with activities that include trading, import, export,
stocking and distribution of industrial raw materials primarily polymers of different types and
grades, as well as raw materials for packaging industries. Our partnership with industry-leading
producers allows us to offer a diverse product portfolio, providing customers with the best
solutions for their projects and applications.

[ Read More ][34]

## Service Excellence

VeeChem is a diverse and fast growing company offerning a wide range of services and activites that
include Distribution & Trading
[ Know More ][35]

## Global Reach

From our head office in the UAE VeeChem is represented across 4 countries and 22 countries making us
a truly global player
[ Know More ][36]

## Key Offerings

VeeChem is at the forefront of innovation offering the latest in polymers, additives and raw
materials that the industry has to offer
[ Know more ][37]

## Corporate Social Responsibility

When it comes to sustainability, VeeChem Global adopts to various environmental initiatives towards
proper utilization of plastic products. VeeChem Global has partnered with companies that support and
promote sustainability, environment friendly and ecological responsibility, to make sure that social
initiative will continue throughout the years.

[ Read More ][38]

VeeChem Global is a name trusted when it comes to the leading **raw plastic material stockiest and
distributor in The UAE and East Africa,** especially for industrial polymers. We are also known for
our extensive involvement in the research and development with manufacturers and new entrants  of
new and existing products. Ranging from **high impact polystyrene sheet to expanded polystyrene
foam,** we are able to support in consistent supply of all good quality products. 



Elaborating VeeChem Global value propositions, our company has been synonymous to trust as our
customers have always been valued. We always ensure that all our customers always get on-time
deliveries. VeeChem Global has fully automated plants to ensure consistent material quality and a
safe working environment for its employees.  



### Vision

To become a dominant multi-location raw plastic material production and distribution company in UAE
and Africa, while establishing itself as a top-performing partner to industries. We aim to keep
growing by adding multiple product ranges.



### Mission

To be a The One Stop Shop for all Industrial Raw Material Requirements, for our customers.

To provide the best quality material to the clients based on advanced technology ensuring to meet
the challenging and ever-increasing market demands.

– We always respect the strength of our team, clients, as well as associates.

– To honor all commitments we undertake.

# From seed plantingto the final
# delivery of goods

Zenith Eclipse plays a pivotal role in the agricultural and energy sectors. With a strong presence
in over 40 countries, we manage the entire value chain from cultivation and production to global
distribution, international trade, and logistics. Our commitment to excellence ensures seamless
operations, connecting high-quality products with markets worldwide.

Key Operations
Zenith Eclipse specializes in cultivating, processing, and distributing high-quality grains,
lentils, and seeds—including sunflower seeds, flaxseeds, and rapeseeds. With modern facilities, we
produce wheat flour and related wheat products to meet market needs.
[icon]
Expansion into Petrochemicals
We’ve also expanded into petrochemicals—including ethylene, propylene, and polyethylene—supporting
wider industrial demand and strengthening our reach across multiple sectors.
Our presence stretches across 40+ nations, marking us as a key player in connecting high-quality
products with the markets that need them most. 40+

We’re committed to providing seeds you can count on—quality, reliable supply, and a responsible
approach from sourcing to delivery. We work to meet your needs and expectations while supporting
long-term, sustainable growth across the agricultural sector.

### Quality You Can Trust

From selection to final shipment, we keep a close eye on quality standards at every step. This focus
helps ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and products that support strong results
season after season.

### Strong Distribution and On-Time Delivery

Our distribution network for grains and seeds is built to keep premium products accessible across a
wide range of agricultural markets. With efficient supply chain management, we make sure deliveries
arrive on time while maintaining the same high standards every time.

### Sustainable Agriculture

Sustainability is central to how we work. We support farming practices that strengthen integrity,
improve resource efficiency, and help farmers remain profitable—while also protecting soil health
and biodiversity for the future.

### Seed Processing with Purpose

After oil extraction, we turn the remaining seed meal into a valuable, nutrient-rich resource for
both livestock and plants. This approach supports healthier animal feed and helps ensure nothing
goes to waste—using the same strict quality standards applied to our seeds.

### Harvest Season and Global Reach

Harvest season is where a full year of work comes together. Our team carefully harvests, processes,
and stores seeds to protect quality, viability, and consistency. Backed by a global supply network,
we source from multiple regions and manage shipping efficiently so customers receive high-quality
products wherever they are.

## Innovation in Action

We champion a culture of innovation across our agriculture, energy, petrochemicals, and logistics
divisions. From precision farming and clean energy solutions to advanced petrochemical processes and
driven logistics, our teams constantly explore new ideas to drive efficiency and sustainability in
every sector. By turning fresh ideas into real‑world applications, we stay ahead of industry
challenges and deliver greater value to our customers and partners.

## Global Reach, Local Impact

Operating in over many countries, our influence is truly global—we help feed populations and fuel
industries by delivering essential commodities where they’re needed most. At the same time, we
believe in giving back: we work hand‑in‑hand with farming communities, support education and
environmental initiatives, and invest in the well‑being of the regions we call home. By balancing
worldwide impact with local commitment, Zenith Eclipse Co turns global success into shared
prosperity for communities and customers alike.

farm, in energy facilities, at petrochemical plants, or in our logistics centers, every team member

### [What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?

Our mission is to transform lives, industries, and communities through unparalleled solutions in
global agribusiness, energy, and logistics. By placing safety, sustainability, and well-being at the
heart of every endeavor, we strive to build a future where innovation and responsibility flourish
side by side.

### [What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?

We envision a thriving, interconnected world where breakthroughs in agriculture, petrochemicals, and
logistics drive prosperity for all. At Zenith Eclipse Co, we continuously push boundaries and
redefine global standards, connecting people and businesses in a shared quest for a more sustainable
and progressive tomorrow.

### [How does Zenith Eclipse Co differ from others?] How does Zenith Eclipse Co differ from others?

Zenith Eclipse Co is not just a company—it’s a movement. Operating in over 40 countries, we bridge
the gap between top-quality products and the most demanding international markets. Our commitment to
excellence underpins a collaborative, forward-thinking culture, fueling our vision of a globally
unified community that transcends conventional business norms.

### [Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?] Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?

We support a diverse spectrum of industries, spanning agribusiness, renewable energy,
petrochemicals, logistics, and beyond. Our expertise allows us to integrate cutting-edge solutions
